### Task 2.5: Platform OAuth callback broker and per-platform redirect registration

Uno's `WebAuthenticationBroker` covers Android, iOS and WASM. It is **not implemented on Skia desktop** (`WebAuthenticationBrokerProvider.skia.cs` throws `NotImplementedException`) and is unsupported on WinAppSDK, so those two heads get their own paths: the existing `mzikmund-app://oauthcallback` protocol activation on Windows, and a loopback `HttpListener` on desktop.

**Files:**
- Create: `src/app/MZikmund.App.Core/Services/Account/IOAuthCallbackBroker.cs`
- Create: `src/app/MZikmund.App.Core/Services/Account/OAuthCallbackBroker.cs`
- Create: `src/app/MZikmund.App/Platforms/Android/WebAuthenticationBrokerActivity.Android.cs`
- Modify: `src/app/MZikmund.App/Platforms/iOS/Info.plist` (add `CFBundleURLTypes`)
- Verify only, no edit: `src/app/MZikmund.App/Package.appxmanifest`, `src/app/MZikmund.App/Platforms/Windows/Program.cs`
- Test: covered by `src/app/MZikmund.App.Core.Tests/Services/Account/SupabaseCallbackParserTests.cs` (Task 2.3) for the parsing behaviour; the browser plumbing is verified by build and manual run.

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: `SupabaseConfig` (Task 2.1).
- Produces: `public interface IOAuthCallbackBroker` in `MZikmund.Services.Account` with `Uri CallbackUri { get; }`, `Task<Uri> AuthenticateAsync(Uri authorizeUri, Uri callbackUri, CancellationToken cancellationToken)`, `void CompleteCallback(Uri callbackUri)`; and `public sealed class OAuthCallbackBroker : IOAuthCallbackBroker` with ctor `OAuthCallbackBroker(IOptions<SupabaseConfig> config)`.

- [ ] **Step 1: Create the broker interface**

Create `src/app/MZikmund.App.Core/Services/Account/IOAuthCallbackBroker.cs`:

```csharp
namespace MZikmund.Services.Account;

/// <summary>
/// Drives the browser leg of the OAuth flow and returns the callback URI the provider redirected to.
/// </summary>
public interface IOAuthCallbackBroker
{
	/// <summary>
	/// Gets the redirect URI for the current platform head. Every value must be allow-listed in
	/// Supabase under Authentication &gt; URL Configuration &gt; Redirect URLs.
	/// </summary>
	Uri CallbackUri { get; }

	Task<Uri> AuthenticateAsync(Uri authorizeUri, Uri callbackUri, CancellationToken cancellationToken);

	/// <summary>
	/// Completes a pending Windows sign-in. Called from protocol activation; a no-op elsewhere.
	/// </summary>
	void CompleteCallback(Uri callbackUri);
}
```

- [ ] **Step 2: Create the broker implementation**

Create `src/app/MZikmund.App.Core/Services/Account/OAuthCallbackBroker.cs`:

```csharp
using Microsoft.Extensions.Options;

#if __ANDROID__ || __IOS__ || __WASM__
using Windows.Security.Authentication.Web;
#endif

namespace MZikmund.Services.Account;

public sealed class OAuthCallbackBroker : IOAuthCallbackBroker
{
	private readonly IOptions<SupabaseConfig> _config;
	private TaskCompletionSource<Uri>? _pendingCallback;

	public OAuthCallbackBroker(IOptions<SupabaseConfig> config)
	{
		_config = config ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(config));
	}

	public Uri CallbackUri =>
#if __WASM__
		new Uri(_config.Value.WasmCallbackUri);
#elif WINDOWS || __ANDROID__ || __IOS__
		new Uri(_config.Value.CallbackUri);
#else
		new Uri(_config.Value.DesktopCallbackUri);
#endif

	public async Task<Uri> AuthenticateAsync(Uri authorizeUri, Uri callbackUri, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
	{
		if (authorizeUri is null)
		{
			throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(authorizeUri));
		}

		if (callbackUri is null)
		{
			throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(callbackUri));
		}

#if WINDOWS
		// WinAppSDK has no WebAuthenticationBroker. The system browser redirects to the
		// mzikmund-app:// scheme declared in Package.appxmanifest, which reactivates the app and
		// lands in MZikmundApp.OnUriCallback -> CompleteCallback.
		TaskCompletionSource<Uri> pending = new(TaskCreationOptions.RunContinuationsAsynchronously);
		_pendingCallback = pending;

		try
		{
			if (!await Windows.System.Launcher.LaunchUriAsync(authorizeUri))
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException("Could not open the browser to sign in.");
			}

			using var registration = cancellationToken.Register(() => pending.TrySetCanceled(cancellationToken));
			return await pending.Task;
		}
		finally
		{
			_pendingCallback = null;
		}
#elif __ANDROID__ || __IOS__ || __WASM__
		var result = await WebAuthenticationBroker.AuthenticateAsync(
			WebAuthenticationOptions.None,
			authorizeUri,
			callbackUri);

		if (result.ResponseStatus != WebAuthenticationStatus.Success)
		{
			throw new InvalidOperationException(
				$"Sign-in did not complete ({result.ResponseStatus}, detail {result.ResponseErrorDetail}).");
		}

		return new Uri(result.ResponseData);
#else
		// Skia desktop: Uno's WebAuthenticationBroker is not implemented there, so use the
		// standard desktop pattern - system browser plus a loopback listener on a fixed port.
		using System.Net.HttpListener listener = new();
		listener.Prefixes.Add(callbackUri.GetLeftPart(UriPartial.Path).TrimEnd('/') + "/");
		listener.Start();

		try
		{
			if (!await Windows.System.Launcher.LaunchUriAsync(authorizeUri))
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException("Could not open the browser to sign in.");
			}

			var context = await listener.GetContextAsync().WaitAsync(cancellationToken);
			var requestUri = context.Request.Url ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("The callback carried no URI.");

			var body = System.Text.Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(
				"<html><body>You are signed in. You can close this tab and return to the app.</body></html>");
			context.Response.ContentType = "text/html; charset=utf-8";
			context.Response.ContentLength64 = body.Length;
			await context.Response.OutputStream.WriteAsync(body, cancellationToken);
			context.Response.Close();

			return requestUri;
		}
		finally
		{
			listener.Stop();
		}
#endif
	}

	public void CompleteCallback(Uri callbackUri)
	{
		if (callbackUri is null)
		{
			throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(callbackUri));
		}

		_pendingCallback?.TrySetResult(callbackUri);
	}
}
```

- [ ] **Step 3: Add the Android activity that receives the custom-scheme redirect**

Create `src/app/MZikmund.App/Platforms/Android/WebAuthenticationBrokerActivity.Android.cs`:

```csharp
using Android.App;
using Android.Content.PM;
using Uno.AuthenticationBroker;

namespace MZikmund.App.Droid;

/// <summary>
/// Receives the mzikmund-app:// redirect and hands it to Uno's WebAuthenticationBroker.
/// The class name is irrelevant; the IntentFilter attribute is what matters.
/// </summary>
[Activity(NoHistory = true, LaunchMode = LaunchMode.SingleTop, Exported = true)]
[IntentFilter(
	new[] { Android.Content.Intent.ActionView },
	Categories = new[] { Android.Content.Intent.CategoryDefault, Android.Content.Intent.CategoryBrowsable },
	DataScheme = "mzikmund-app")]
public class WebAuthenticationBrokerActivity : WebAuthenticationBrokerActivityBase
{
}
```

`Exported = true` is required from Android 12 onwards. `Platforms/Android/**` is compiled only into the android head, so this file does not affect the other TFMs.

**Files:**

- Modify: `src/app/MZikmund.App.Core/Services/Account/UserService.cs` (replaced in full)
- Delete: `src/app/MZikmund.App.Core/Services/Account/AuthenticationInfo.cs`
- Test: none — this class is a thin orchestration over `Supabase.Gotrue.Client`, which cannot be constructed without network configuration. Every branch that *can* be pure was already extracted and tested in Tasks 2.2–2.4.

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: `SupabaseClaimsReader.Read(string)` (2.2), `SupabaseCallbackParser.Parse(Uri)` and `SupabaseCallbackResult` (2.3), `ISupabaseSessionStore` (2.4), `IOAuthCallbackBroker` (2.5).
- Produces: `public enum SupabaseSignInProvider { Google, Apple }` and `public interface IUserService` in `MZikmund.Services.Account` with:
  - `bool IsLoggedIn { get; }`, `bool IsAdmin { get; }`, `bool NeedsRefresh { get; }`
  - `string? UserId { get; }`, `string? UserName { get; }`, `string? AvatarUrl { get; }`, `string? AccessToken { get; }`
  - `event EventHandler? AuthenticationStateChanged;`
  - `Task<bool> TryRestoreSessionAsync()`, `Task SignInAsync(SupabaseSignInProvider provider)`, `Task SendEmailCodeAsync(string email)`, `Task VerifyEmailCodeAsync(string email, string code)`, `Task SignOutAsync()`
  - and `public sealed class UserService : IUserService` with ctor `UserService(Supabase.Gotrue.Client client, IOAuthCallbackBroker callbackBroker, ISupabaseSessionStore sessionStore, ILogger<UserService> logger)`.

> **THIS IS THE AUTHORITATIVE `IUserService` SURFACE. EVERY LATER PHASE BINDS TO EXACTLY THESE NAMES.**
> The four auth methods and the provider enum are, verbatim:
>
> ```csharp
> Task SignInAsync(SupabaseSignInProvider provider);
> Task SendEmailCodeAsync(string email);
> Task VerifyEmailCodeAsync(string email, string code);
> Task SignOutAsync();
>
> public enum SupabaseSignInProvider { Google, Apple }
> ```
>
> `SupabaseSignInProvider` lives in namespace `MZikmund.Services.Account` and has exactly TWO members,
> `Google` and `Apple` — there is deliberately **no** `Email` member, because email OTP is not an OAuth
> provider and never flows through `SignInAsync`. A sign-in sheet offering email must call
> `SendEmailCodeAsync(email)` and then `VerifyEmailCodeAsync(email, code)` directly.
>
> The following names do **not** exist anywhere after this task and must never be called by a later
> phase: `AuthenticateAsync(...)`, `LogoutAsync()`, `SendEmailOtpAsync(...)`, `VerifyEmailOtpAsync(...)`,
> and the type `SignInProvider`. They are Auth0-era or invented names; Step 1 below deletes the Auth0
> contract in full. Phase 10 in particular MUST use `SignInAsync(SupabaseSignInProvider)`,

- [ ] **Step 1: Replace the service contract**

Write `src/app/MZikmund.App.Core/Services/Account/IUserService.cs` in full:

```csharp
namespace MZikmund.Services.Account;

/// <summary>
/// The identity providers offered by the app. Password sign-in stays disabled in Supabase.
/// </summary>
public enum SupabaseSignInProvider
{
	Google,
	Apple
}

public interface IUserService
{
	bool IsLoggedIn { get; }

	/// <summary>
	/// Gets a value indicating whether the signed-in user carries app_metadata.role == "admin".
	/// This gates UI only; the API enforces the real boundary.
	/// </summary>
	bool IsAdmin { get; }

	bool NeedsRefresh { get; }

	string? UserId { get; }

	string? UserName { get; }

	string? AvatarUrl { get; }

	string? AccessToken { get; }

	/// <summary>
	/// Raised whenever the signed-in state changes. May be raised from a background thread.
	/// </summary>
	event EventHandler? AuthenticationStateChanged;

	/// <summary>
	/// Restores and, if needed, refreshes a persisted session. Never interactive and never throws.
	/// </summary>
	Task<bool> TryRestoreSessionAsync();

	/// <summary>
	/// Runs the interactive PKCE sign-in for the given provider.
	/// </summary>
	Task SignInAsync(SupabaseSignInProvider provider);

	/// <summary>
	/// Emails a six-digit sign-in code.
	/// </summary>
	Task SendEmailCodeAsync(string email);

	/// <summary>
	/// Redeems a six-digit sign-in code.
	/// </summary>
	Task VerifyEmailCodeAsync(string email, string code);

	Task SignOutAsync();
}
```

- [ ] **Step 3: Replace the implementation**

Write `src/app/MZikmund.App.Core/Services/Account/UserService.cs` in full:

```csharp
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Supabase.Gotrue;
using static Supabase.Gotrue.Constants;

namespace MZikmund.Services.Account;

public sealed class UserService : IUserService
{
	private readonly Client _client;
	private readonly IOAuthCallbackBroker _callbackBroker;
	private readonly ISupabaseSessionStore _sessionStore;
	private readonly ILogger<UserService> _logger;
	private SupabaseClaims? _claims;

	public UserService(
		Client client,
		IOAuthCallbackBroker callbackBroker,
		ISupabaseSessionStore sessionStore,
		ILogger<UserService> logger)
	{
		_client = client ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(client));
		_callbackBroker = callbackBroker ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(callbackBroker));
		_sessionStore = sessionStore ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(sessionStore));
		_logger = logger ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(logger));

		ReadClaims(_client.CurrentSession);
	}

	public bool IsLoggedIn => _claims is not null;

	public bool IsAdmin => _claims?.IsAdmin == true;

	public string? UserId => _claims?.UserId;

	public string? UserName => _claims?.DisplayName;

	public string? AvatarUrl => _claims?.AvatarUrl;

	public string? AccessToken => _client.CurrentSession?.AccessToken;

	public event EventHandler? AuthenticationStateChanged;

	public bool NeedsRefresh
	{
		get
		{
			if (_client.CurrentSession is not { } session)
			{
				return false;
			}

			// The old Auth0 implementation had this comparison inverted, so it only ever reported
			// "needs refresh" five minutes AFTER expiry - every expiry produced a burst of 401s.
			var expiresOn = session.CreatedAt.ToUniversalTime().AddSeconds(session.ExpiresIn);
			return expiresOn <= DateTime.UtcNow.AddMinutes(5);
		}
	}

	public async Task<bool> TryRestoreSessionAsync()
	{
		try
		{
			var session = await _client.RetrieveSessionAsync();
			ApplySession(session);
		}
		catch (Exception ex)
		{
			_logger.LogError(ex, "Could not restore the Supabase session.");
			ApplySession(null);
		}

		return IsLoggedIn;
	}

	public async Task SignInAsync(SupabaseSignInProvider provider)
	{
		var callbackUri = _callbackBroker.CallbackUri;

		var authState = await _client.SignIn(ToProvider(provider), new SignInOptions
		{
			// SignInOptions.FlowType defaults to Implicit, which yields a null PKCEVerifier and an
			// authorize URL with no challenge. PKCE must be set explicitly.
			FlowType = OAuthFlowType.PKCE,
			RedirectTo = callbackUri.OriginalString,
			Scopes = provider == SupabaseSignInProvider.Apple ? "email name" : "email profile"
		});

		var returnedUri = await _callbackBroker.AuthenticateAsync(authState.Uri, callbackUri, CancellationToken.None);
		var callback = SupabaseCallbackParser.Parse(returnedUri);

		if (callback.Error is { } error)
		{
			throw new InvalidOperationException($"Sign-in failed: {error} {callback.ErrorDescription}".TrimEnd());
		}

		// Validate the state only when the provider actually echoed one - GoTrue does not always
		// round-trip it. PKCE already binds the exchange to the verifier held in this process.
		if (callback.State is { } returnedState &&
			!string.Equals(returnedState, authState.State, StringComparison.Ordinal))
		{
			throw new InvalidOperationException("Sign-in failed: the returned OAuth state did not match.");
		}

		if (callback.Code is not { } code)
		{
			throw new InvalidOperationException("Sign-in failed: no authorization code was returned.");
		}

		if (authState.PKCEVerifier is not { Length: > 0 } verifier)
		{
			throw new InvalidOperationException("Sign-in failed: the PKCE verifier was not generated.");
		}

		var session = await _client.ExchangeCodeForSession(verifier, code);
		ApplySession(session);
	}

	public async Task SendEmailCodeAsync(string email)
	{
		if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(email))
		{
			throw new ArgumentException("Email must not be empty.", nameof(email));
		}

		await _client.SignInWithOtp(new SignInWithPasswordlessEmailOptions(email)
		{
			ShouldCreateUser = true
		});
	}

	public async Task VerifyEmailCodeAsync(string email, string code)
	{
		if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(email))
		{
			throw new ArgumentException("Email must not be empty.", nameof(email));
		}

		if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(code))
		{
			throw new ArgumentException("Code must not be empty.", nameof(code));
		}

		// EmailOtpType.MagicLink is the method default and is the wrong wire type for a
		// six-digit code - it must be EmailOtpType.Email.
		var session = await _client.VerifyOTP(email, code, EmailOtpType.Email);
		ApplySession(session);
	}

	public async Task SignOutAsync()
	{
		try
		{
			await _client.SignOut(SignOutScope.Global);
		}
		catch (Exception ex)
		{
			_logger.LogError(ex, "Supabase sign-out failed; clearing the local session anyway.");
		}

		_sessionStore.Clear();
		ApplySession(null);
	}

	private void ApplySession(Session? session)
	{
		ReadClaims(session);
		AuthenticationStateChanged?.Invoke(this, EventArgs.Empty);
	}

	private void ReadClaims(Session? session)
	{
		if (session?.AccessToken is not { Length: > 0 } accessToken)
		{
			_claims = null;
			return;
		}

		try
		{
			_claims = SupabaseClaimsReader.Read(accessToken);
		}
		catch (Exception ex)
		{
			_logger.LogError(ex, "Could not read the Supabase access token.");
			_claims = null;
		}
	}

	private static Provider ToProvider(SupabaseSignInProvider provider) => provider switch
	{
		SupabaseSignInProvider.Google => Provider.Google,
		SupabaseSignInProvider.Apple => Provider.Apple,
		_ => throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(provider), provider, "Unsupported sign-in provider.")
	};
}
```

- [ ] **Step 2: Add the Supabase client factory**

In the same file, add this method immediately after `ConfigureServices`:

```csharp
	private static Supabase.Gotrue.Client CreateSupabaseClient(IServiceProvider provider)
	{
		var config = provider.GetRequiredService<IOptions<SupabaseConfig>>().Value;

		if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(config.ProjectRef) || config.ProjectRef.Contains("Placeholder") ||
			string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(config.PublishableKey) || config.PublishableKey.Contains("Placeholder"))
		{
			throw new InvalidOperationException(
				"SupabaseConfig:ProjectRef and SupabaseConfig:PublishableKey are not configured. " +
				"See docs/SUPABASE_AUTH.md.");
		}

		Supabase.Gotrue.ClientOptions options = new()
		{
			Url = $"https://{config.ProjectRef}.supabase.co/auth/v1",
			AutoRefreshToken = true
		};

		// New-format publishable keys go in the apikey header only - never in Authorization.
		options.Headers["apikey"] = config.PublishableKey;

		Supabase.Gotrue.Client client = new(options);
		client.SetPersistence(provider.GetRequiredService<SupabaseSessionPersistence>());
		client.LoadSession();
		return client;
	}
```

```csharp
using Microsoft.UI.Dispatching;
using MZikmund.Models.Dialogs;
using MZikmund.Services.Account;
using MZikmund.Services.Dialogs;
using MZikmund.Services.Navigation;
using Uno.Disposables;

namespace MZikmund.ViewModels;

public partial class WindowShellViewModel : ViewModelBase
{
	private readonly IWindowShellProvider _provider;
	private readonly INavigationService _navigationService;
	private readonly IUserService _userService;
	private readonly IDialogService _dialogService;
	private RefCountDisposable? _refCountDisposable;

	public WindowShellViewModel(
		IWindowShellProvider provider,
		INavigationService navigationService,
		IUserService userService,
		IDialogService dialogService)
	{
		_provider = provider ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(provider));
		_navigationService = navigationService ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(navigationService));
		_userService = userService ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(userService));
		_dialogService = dialogService ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(dialogService));

		_userService.AuthenticationStateChanged += OnAuthenticationStateChanged;
		UpdateAuthenticationState();

		// TryRestoreSessionAsync never throws; it logs and reports false instead.
		_ = _userService.TryRestoreSessionAsync();
	}

	public string Title { get; set; } = "Martin Zikmund";

	[ObservableProperty]
	public partial bool IsLoading { get; set; }

	[ObservableProperty]
	public partial string LoadingStatusMessage { get; set; } = "";

	[ObservableProperty]
	public partial bool IsLoggedIn { get; set; }

	/// <summary>
	/// Gets a value indicating whether the signed-in user is an administrator. The Admin navigation
	/// section binds to this and NOT to <see cref="IsLoggedIn"/> - with Supabase every commenter
	/// signs in, so an IsLoggedIn gate would expose the moderation UI to every reader.
	/// </summary>
	[ObservableProperty]
	public partial bool IsAdmin { get; set; }

	[RelayCommand]
	private async Task LoginAsync()
	{
		try
		{
			await _userService.SignInAsync(SupabaseSignInProvider.Google);
		}
		catch (Exception ex)
		{
			await _dialogService.ShowStatusMessageAsync(
				StatusMessageDialogType.Error,
				"Could not sign in",
				$"Sign-in did not complete. {ex.Message}");
		}

		UpdateAuthenticationState();
	}

	[RelayCommand]
	private async Task LogoutAsync()
	{
		await _userService.SignOutAsync();
		UpdateAuthenticationState();
		_navigationService.Navigate<BlogViewModel>();
	}

	private void OnAuthenticationStateChanged(object? sender, EventArgs e)
	{
#if __WASM__
		UpdateAuthenticationState();
#else
		if (_provider.DispatcherQueue.HasThreadAccess)
		{
			UpdateAuthenticationState();
		}
		else
		{
			_provider.DispatcherQueue.TryEnqueue(DispatcherQueuePriority.Normal, UpdateAuthenticationState);
		}
#endif
	}

	private void UpdateAuthenticationState()
	{
		IsLoggedIn = _userService.IsLoggedIn;
		IsAdmin = _userService.IsAdmin;
	}

	public IDisposable BeginLoading()
	{
		LoadingStatusMessage = "";
		if (_refCountDisposable != null && !_refCountDisposable.IsDisposed)
		{
			return _refCountDisposable.GetDisposable();
		}

		IsLoading = true;
		_refCountDisposable = new RefCountDisposable(Disposable.Create(
			() => // TODO: Await TryEnequeAsync
			{
#if __WASM__
				IsLoading = false;
				return;
#else
				if (_provider.DispatcherQueue.HasThreadAccess)
				{
					IsLoading = false;
				}
				else
				{
					_provider.DispatcherQueue.TryEnqueue(DispatcherQueuePriority.Normal, () =>
					{
						if (_refCountDisposable == null || _refCountDisposable.IsDisposed)
						{
							IsLoading = false;
						}
					});
				}
#endif
			}));
		return _refCountDisposable;
	}

	public void BackRequested() => _navigationService.GoBack();
}
```

```bash
cat >> docs/SUPABASE_AUTH.md <<'EOF'

## Uno app

The app uses the `Supabase.Gotrue` NuGet package (identity only — no Postgrest, Realtime, Storage
or Functions). Configuration lives in the `SupabaseConfig` object of the **embedded**
`src/app/MZikmund.App/appsettings.json`, bound by type name via `.Section<SupabaseConfig>()`.
Everything in that file ships inside the binary, which is fine for the publishable key and
unacceptable for anything else. No secret key ever goes in the app.

| Key | Value |
|---|---|
| `SupabaseConfig:ProjectRef` | the project ref; every Supabase URL is derived from it |
| `SupabaseConfig:PublishableKey` | `sb_publishable_...`, sent as the `apikey` header |
| `SupabaseConfig:CallbackUri` | `mzikmund-app://oauthcallback` (Windows, Android, iOS) |
| `SupabaseConfig:DesktopCallbackUri` | `http://localhost:52619/callback/` (Skia desktop) |
| `SupabaseConfig:WasmCallbackUri` | `https://<wasm-origin>/authentication-callback` |

### Redirect URLs to allow-list

In the dashboard under **Authentication > URL Configuration > Redirect URLs** add all of:

```
mzikmund-app://oauthcallback
http://localhost:52619/**
https://mzikmund.dev/**
http://localhost:5000/**
```

Glob rules: `*` matches non-separator characters, `**` matches anything.

### Where each redirect is registered in the repository

| Head | Mechanism | File |
|---|---|---|
| Windows | `windows.protocol` extension, name `mzikmund-app`; activation routed by `MZikmundProgram.OnActivated` | `src/app/MZikmund.App/Package.appxmanifest`, `src/app/MZikmund.App/Platforms/Windows/Program.cs` |
| Android | `[IntentFilter(DataScheme = "mzikmund-app")]` on an activity deriving from `Uno.AuthenticationBroker.WebAuthenticationBrokerActivityBase` | `src/app/MZikmund.App/Platforms/Android/WebAuthenticationBrokerActivity.Android.cs` |
| iOS | `CFBundleURLTypes` / `CFBundleURLSchemes` entry `mzikmund-app` | `src/app/MZikmund.App/Platforms/iOS/Info.plist` |
| WASM | no custom scheme is possible; the redirect must be an https URL on the app's own origin | `SupabaseConfig:WasmCallbackUri` |
| Desktop (Skia) | Uno's `WebAuthenticationBroker` is not implemented; a loopback `HttpListener` on a fixed port is used instead | `src/app/MZikmund.App.Core/Services/Account/OAuthCallbackBroker.cs` |

### Session persistence and refresh

`SupabaseSessionPersistence` implements `IGotrueSessionPersistence<Session>` over
`IAppPreferences.SupabaseSession`. That preference is stored with `roamed: false` on purpose — it
carries a refresh token and roaming settings are plain text synced across the user's devices.
The client is created with `AutoRefreshToken = true`, `client.SetPersistence(...)` and
`client.LoadSession()` in `MZikmundApp.CreateSupabaseClient`. `WindowShellViewModel` calls
`IUserService.TryRestoreSessionAsync()` once at startup, which restores and refreshes.

### Rollout checklist

- [ ] Migrate the project to an asymmetric (ES256) signing key. While the project is still on the
      legacy HS256 secret, `/auth/v1/.well-known/jwks.json` returns `{"keys":[]}` and every API
      call 401s with what looks like a network error.
- [ ] Enable the Google provider: create a **Web application** OAuth client, add
      `https://<ref>.supabase.co/auth/v1/callback` as an authorized redirect URI, paste the client
      id and secret into the dashboard.
- [ ] Enable the Apple provider: App ID with the "Sign in with Apple" capability, a Services ID
      whose return URL is `https://<ref>.supabase.co/auth/v1/callback`, and a Sign in with Apple
      key. Keep the `.p8` — Apple lets you download it once and it is needed for every rotation.
      Enter the **Services ID first** in the dashboard's Client IDs list.
- [ ] Calendar reminder: the Apple client secret expires every 6 months and breaks Apple sign-in
      silently.
- [ ] Enable email OTP and edit the Magic Link template to contain `{{ .Token }}` instead of
      `{{ .ConfirmationURL }}`, otherwise Supabase mails a link and no six-digit code is visible.
- [ ] Add every redirect URL listed above.
- [ ] Paste the real project ref and `sb_publishable_...` key into
      `src/app/MZikmund.App/appsettings.json`, replacing the two `..._Placeholder` values.
- [ ] Grant yourself the admin role, then sign out and back in — `app_metadata` changes only reach
      the client after the access token is re-minted:

```bash
curl -X PUT "https://<project-ref>.supabase.co/auth/v1/admin/users/<user-uuid>" \
  -H "apikey: sb_secret_xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sb_secret_xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"app_metadata": {"role": "admin"}}'
```

  Send **only** `app_metadata`. The same endpoint accepts a top-level `role` field that rewrites
  the Postgres role claim and can lock the account out of PostgREST.
- [ ] Verify in the app that the Admin navigation section appears for you and does **not** appear
      for a second, non-admin test account.
EOF
```

## Phase 3: Comment Data Contracts, Entities, EF Configurations, Migration, and AutoMapper Profile

> **Deliberate deviations from repo convention introduced in this phase (state them in the PR body, do not do them silently):**
> 1. `MZikmund.Web.Data` gains a `ProjectReference` to `MZikmund.DataContracts`. Today the Data project references only `MZikmund.Web.Configuration`. The canonical contract requires `CommentReportEntity.Reason` to be the *same* `CommentReportReason` type the DTOs use, so the reference is mandatory. `MZikmund.DataContracts` has no project references of its own, so no cycle is created.
> 2. Comment relationships declare `.OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Restrict)` explicitly. No existing configuration in the repo specifies delete behaviour at all (`PostConfiguration` has literal `// TODO: Restrict delete` comments). Without this, SQL Server rejects the migration with "may cause cycles or multiple cascade paths", because `CommentEntity` has three FKs and a self-FK.
> 3. This phase adds the repo's first EF *model* test (`CommentModelTests`). It builds the model against the SQL Server provider without ever opening a connection, which is what makes the "forgot `ApplyConfiguration`" trap catchable. There is no `ApplyConfigurationsFromAssembly` in `DatabaseContext` — a forgotten registration line compiles, emits no warning, and silently drops every max length, index and delete behaviour.

### Task 3.1: Comment data contracts (DTOs and enums)

**Files:**
- Test: `src/web/MZikmund.Web.Core.Tests/Contracts/CommentContractsTests.cs` (create)
- Create: `src/app/MZikmund.DataContracts/Blog/Comments/CommentStatus.cs`
- Create: `src/app/MZikmund.DataContracts/Blog/Comments/CommentReportReason.cs`
- Create: `src/app/MZikmund.DataContracts/Blog/Comments/CommentSortOrder.cs`
- Create: `src/app/MZikmund.DataContracts/Blog/Comments/CommentDto.cs`
- Create: `src/app/MZikmund.DataContracts/Blog/Comments/CreateCommentRequest.cs`
- Create: `src/app/MZikmund.DataContracts/Blog/Comments/UpdateCommentRequest.cs`
- Create: `src/app/MZikmund.DataContracts/Blog/Comments/ReportCommentRequest.cs`
- Create: `src/app/MZikmund.DataContracts/Blog/Comments/CommentReportDto.cs`

No csproj change is needed: `MZikmund.DataContracts.csproj` is a plain `Microsoft.NET.Sdk` project and globs every `.cs` file under it. `src/Directory.Build.props` turns on `ImplicitUsings`, so `Guid`, `DateTime` and `Array` need no `using`. `MZikmund.Web.Core` already has a `ProjectReference` to `MZikmund.DataContracts`, and `MZikmund.Web.Core.Tests` references `MZikmund.Web.Core`, so the test project sees these types transitively with no reference edit.

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: nothing. This is the first task of the phase and the first task anywhere that touches comments; it has no dependency on Phase 0, 1 or 2.
- Produces — all in namespace `MZikmund.DataContracts.Blog.Comments`, all `public record` with `required … { get; init; }` members and **zero** `System.Text.Json` attributes (camelCase is applied globally by the serializer context):
  - `CommentDto` — `required Guid Id`, `required Guid PostId`, `Guid? ParentId`, `required string AuthorDisplayName`, `string? AuthorAvatarUrl`, `string? MentionedDisplayName`, `required string Content`, `required string ContentHtml`, `required CommentStatus Status`, `required DateTime CreatedOn`, `DateTime? EditedOn`, `required int UpvoteCount`, `required int ReplyCount`, `required bool HasUpvoted`, `required bool IsOwn`, `CommentDto[] Replies` (defaulted to `Array.Empty<CommentDto>()`)
  - `CreateCommentRequest` — `required string Content`, `Guid? ParentId`
  - `UpdateCommentRequest` — `required string Content`
  - `ReportCommentRequest` — `required CommentReportReason Reason`, `string? Note`
  - `CommentReportDto` — `required Guid CommentId`, `required Guid AuthorId`, `required CommentDto Comment`, `required int OpenReportCount`, `required CommentReportReason[] Reasons`, `required DateTime FirstReportedOn`
  - `public enum CommentStatus { Visible, DeletedByAuthor, HiddenByModerator }`
  - `public enum CommentReportReason { Spam, Abuse, OffTopic, Other }`
  - `public enum CommentSortOrder { Top, New }`
- **Downstream requirement recorded here so it is not lost** — Phase 6's `GetCommentReportsHandler` builds its `CommentReportDto` values from a `commentRows` **anonymous** projection. That projection MUST select `c.AuthorId` alongside the members it already selects (`c.Id, c.PostId, c.ParentId, AuthorDisplayName, AuthorAvatarUrl, MentionedDisplayName, Content, ContentHtml, Status, CreatedOn, EditedOn, UpvoteCount, ReplyCount`). Without `c.AuthorId` in the anonymous projection there is no `AuthorId` member in scope for the `new CommentReportDto { … }` object initializer built from those rows, and the handler cannot compile. `CommentReportDto` carries its `required Guid AuthorId` member from the start — it is created **with** it here, in this task; Phase 6 is the phase that populates it.

		var missing = expectedRequired
			.Where(name => !type.GetProperty(name)!
				.GetCustomAttributes(inherit: false)
				.Any(attribute => attribute is RequiredMemberAttribute))
			.ToArray();

		// Assert
		Assert.Empty(missing);
	}

	[Fact]
	public void CreateCommentRequest_WithTheSameValues_AreEqual()
	{
		// Arrange
		var parentId = new Guid("33333333-3333-3333-3333-333333333333");

		// Act
		CreateCommentRequest first = new() { Content = "Hi", ParentId = parentId };
		CreateCommentRequest second = new() { Content = "Hi", ParentId = parentId };

		// Assert
		Assert.Equal(first, second);
		Assert.NotSame(first, second);
	}

	[Fact]
	public void RequestContracts_ExposeTheWriteSurface()
	{
		// Arrange
		var note = "Not about the post";

		// Act
		UpdateCommentRequest update = new() { Content = "Edited" };
		ReportCommentRequest report = new() { Reason = CommentReportReason.OffTopic, Note = note };

		// Assert
		Assert.Equal("Edited", update.Content);
		Assert.Equal(CommentReportReason.OffTopic, report.Reason);
		Assert.Equal(note, report.Note);
	}

	[Fact]
	public void CommentReportDto_CarriesTheModerationQueueShape()
	{
		// Arrange
		var comment = CreateDto();
		var reasons = new[] { CommentReportReason.Spam, CommentReportReason.Abuse };
		var firstReportedOn = new DateTime(2026, 8, 11, 9, 0, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc);
		var authorId = new Guid("55555555-5555-5555-5555-555555555555");

		// Act
		CommentReportDto report = new()
		{
			CommentId = comment.Id,
			AuthorId = authorId,
			Comment = comment,
			OpenReportCount = 2,
			Reasons = reasons,
			FirstReportedOn = firstReportedOn,
		};

		// Assert
		Assert.Equal(comment.Id, report.CommentId);
		Assert.Equal(authorId, report.AuthorId);
		Assert.Same(comment, report.Comment);
		Assert.Equal(2, report.OpenReportCount);
		Assert.Equal(reasons, report.Reasons);
		Assert.Equal(firstReportedOn, report.FirstReportedOn);
	}

	[Fact]
	public void Contracts_DeclareExactlyTheEightCanonicalTypes()
	{
		// Arrange
		var expected = new[]
		{
			"CommentDto",
			"CommentReportDto",
			"CommentReportReason",
			"CommentSortOrder",
			"CommentStatus",
			"CreateCommentRequest",
			"ReportCommentRequest",
			"UpdateCommentRequest",
		};

		// Act
		var names = typeof(CommentDto).Assembly
			.GetTypes()
			.Where(type => type.Namespace == ContractNamespace)
			.Select(type => type.Name)
			.OrderBy(name => name, StringComparer.Ordinal)
			.ToArray();

		// Assert
		Assert.Equal(expected, names);
	}

	[Fact]
	public void Contracts_CarryNoSystemTextJsonAttributes()
	{
		// Arrange
		var contractTypes = typeof(CommentDto).Assembly
			.GetTypes()
			.Where(type => type.Namespace == ContractNamespace)
			.ToArray();

		// Act
		var jsonAttributes = contractTypes
			.SelectMany(type => type.GetCustomAttributes(inherit: false)
				.Concat(type.GetProperties().SelectMany(property => property.GetCustomAttributes(inherit: false))))
			.Where(attribute => attribute.GetType().Namespace == "System.Text.Json.Serialization")
			.ToArray();

		// Assert
		Assert.Empty(jsonAttributes);
	}
}

- [ ] **Step 6: Create `CommentDto`**

Create `src/app/MZikmund.DataContracts/Blog/Comments/CommentDto.cs`. Modern DataContracts style, matching `VideoDto`: `public record`, `required … { get; init; }`, XML doc comment per property, no `System.Text.Json` attributes:

```csharp
namespace MZikmund.DataContracts.Blog.Comments;

/// <summary>
/// Represents a single comment on a blog post as returned by the public API.
/// </summary>
public record CommentDto
{
	/// <summary>
	/// Unique identifier of the comment.
	/// </summary>
	public required Guid Id { get; init; }

	/// <summary>
	/// Identifier of the post the comment belongs to.
	/// </summary>
	public required Guid PostId { get; init; }

	/// <summary>
	/// Identifier of the parent comment, or <c>null</c> for a top-level comment.
	/// </summary>
	public Guid? ParentId { get; init; }

	/// <summary>
	/// Display name of the author at the time the comment was read.
	/// </summary>
	public required string AuthorDisplayName { get; init; }

	/// <summary>
	/// Absolute URL of the author's avatar, when the identity provider supplied one.
	/// </summary>
	public string? AuthorAvatarUrl { get; init; }

	/// <summary>
	/// Display name of the comment this reply was originally aimed at, when the reply was
	/// re-pointed to its grandparent to keep the thread two levels deep.
	/// </summary>
	public string? MentionedDisplayName { get; init; }

	/// <summary>
	/// Raw markdown exactly as the author typed it, used by the native app.
	/// </summary>
	public required string Content { get; init; }

	/// <summary>
	/// Rendered and sanitized HTML, used by the web front-end.
	/// </summary>
	public required string ContentHtml { get; init; }

	/// <summary>
	/// Visibility status of the comment.
	/// </summary>
	public required CommentStatus Status { get; init; }

	/// <summary>
	/// UTC timestamp of when the comment was posted.
	/// </summary>
	public required DateTime CreatedOn { get; init; }

	/// <summary>
	/// UTC timestamp of the last edit, or <c>null</c> when the comment was never edited.
	/// </summary>
	public DateTime? EditedOn { get; init; }

	/// <summary>
	/// Number of upvotes the comment has received.
	/// </summary>
	public required int UpvoteCount { get; init; }

	/// <summary>
	/// Total number of replies, which may exceed the length of <see cref="Replies"/>.
	/// </summary>
	public required int ReplyCount { get; init; }

	/// <summary>
	/// Whether the caller has upvoted this comment.
	/// </summary>
	public required bool HasUpvoted { get; init; }

	/// <summary>
	/// Whether the caller is the author of this comment.
	/// </summary>
	public required bool IsOwn { get; init; }

	/// <summary>
	/// First three replies ordered by <see cref="CreatedOn"/> ascending. Empty on a reply.
	/// </summary>
	public CommentDto[] Replies { get; init; } = Array.Empty<CommentDto>();
}
```

- [ ] **Step 10: Create `CommentReportDto`**

Create `src/app/MZikmund.DataContracts/Blog/Comments/CommentReportDto.cs`. One entry per reported comment, not one per report — the moderation queue groups reports by comment:

```csharp
namespace MZikmund.DataContracts.Blog.Comments;

/// <summary>
/// One entry of the moderation queue: a comment together with its open reports.
/// </summary>
public record CommentReportDto
{
	/// <summary>
	/// Identifier of the reported comment.
	/// </summary>
	public required Guid CommentId { get; init; }

	/// <summary>
	/// Identifier of the comment author, so the queue can ban directly.
	/// </summary>
	public required Guid AuthorId { get; init; }

	/// <summary>
	/// The reported comment itself.
	/// </summary>
	public required CommentDto Comment { get; init; }

	/// <summary>
	/// Number of unresolved reports filed against the comment.
	/// </summary>
	public required int OpenReportCount { get; init; }

	/// <summary>
	/// Distinct reasons given across the open reports.
	/// </summary>
	public required CommentReportReason[] Reasons { get; init; }

	/// <summary>
	/// UTC timestamp of the earliest open report, used to order the queue.
	/// </summary>
	public required DateTime FirstReportedOn { get; init; }
}
```

Create `src/web/MZikmund.Web.Core.Tests/Data/CommentModelTests.cs`. The namespace mirrors the folder. No database connection is ever opened — `context.Model` builds from the provider metadata alone. `UseLazyLoadingProxies()` is switched on deliberately so the test also fails if a navigation is not `virtual`:

```csharp
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.Metadata;
using MZikmund.Web.Data;
using MZikmund.Web.Data.Entities;

namespace MZikmund.Web.Core.Tests.Data;

public class CommentModelTests
{
	private static DatabaseContext CreateContext()
	{
		var options = new DbContextOptionsBuilder<DatabaseContext>()
			.UseLazyLoadingProxies()
			.UseSqlServer("Server=(localdb)\\MSSQLLocalDB;Database=MZikmundModelOnly")
			.Options;

		return new DatabaseContext(options);
	}

	[Fact]
	public void Model_CommentTables_UseSingularNames()
	{
		// Arrange
		using var context = CreateContext();

		// Act
		var commentTable = context.Model.FindEntityType(typeof(CommentEntity))!.GetTableName();
		var authorTable = context.Model.FindEntityType(typeof(CommentAuthorEntity))!.GetTableName();
		var voteTable = context.Model.FindEntityType(typeof(CommentVoteEntity))!.GetTableName();
		var reportTable = context.Model.FindEntityType(typeof(CommentReportEntity))!.GetTableName();

		// Assert
		Assert.Equal("Comment", commentTable);
		Assert.Equal("CommentAuthor", authorTable);
		Assert.Equal("CommentVote", voteTable);
		Assert.Equal("CommentReport", reportTable);
	}

	[Fact]

		var comment = context.Model.FindEntityType(typeof(CommentEntity))!;

		// Act
		var maxLength = comment.FindProperty(nameof(CommentEntity.Content))!.GetMaxLength();

		// Assert
		Assert.Equal(4000, maxLength);
	}

	[Fact]

		// Arrange

		var comment = context.Model.FindEntityType(typeof(CommentEntity))!;

		// Act

		// Assert

		Assert.False(property.IsNullable);

- [ ] **Step 5: Create `CommentConfiguration`**

Create `src/web/MZikmund.Web.Data/Entities/Configurations/CommentConfiguration.cs`. `Content` is capped at 4000 to match the server-side limit; `ContentHtml` is left unbounded so it becomes `nvarchar(max)`. All three relationships restrict:

```csharp
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.Metadata.Builders;

namespace MZikmund.Web.Data.Entities.Configurations;

internal sealed class CommentConfiguration : IEntityTypeConfiguration<CommentEntity>
{
	public void Configure(EntityTypeBuilder<CommentEntity> builder)
	{
		builder.Property(c => c.Id).ValueGeneratedNever();
		builder.Property(c => c.Content).IsRequired().HasMaxLength(4000);
		builder.Property(c => c.ContentHtml).IsRequired();
		builder.Property(c => c.MentionedDisplayName).HasMaxLength(256);

		builder.HasIndex(c => new { c.PostId, c.ParentId, c.CreatedOn });
		builder.HasIndex(c => c.AuthorId);

		builder
			.HasOne(c => c.Post)
			.WithMany()
			.HasForeignKey(c => c.PostId)
			.OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Restrict);

		builder
			.HasOne(c => c.Parent)
			.WithMany(c => c.Replies)
			.HasForeignKey(c => c.ParentId)
			.OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Restrict);

		builder
			.HasOne(c => c.Author)
			.WithMany()
			.HasForeignKey(c => c.AuthorId)
			.OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Restrict);
	}
}
```

- [ ] **Step 7: Create `CommentVoteConfiguration`**

Create `src/web/MZikmund.Web.Data/Entities/Configurations/CommentVoteConfiguration.cs`. `CommentVoteEntity` carries no navigations, so both relationships use the navigation-less `HasOne<T>()` overload. The composite key is what makes repeated votes a primary-key violation rather than a duplicate row:

```csharp
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.Metadata.Builders;

namespace MZikmund.Web.Data.Entities.Configurations;

internal sealed class CommentVoteConfiguration : IEntityTypeConfiguration<CommentVoteEntity>
{
	public void Configure(EntityTypeBuilder<CommentVoteEntity> builder)
	{
		builder.HasKey(v => new { v.CommentId, v.AuthorId });

		builder
			.HasOne<CommentEntity>()
			.WithMany(c => c.Votes)
			.HasForeignKey(v => v.CommentId)
			.OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Restrict);

		builder
			.HasOne<CommentAuthorEntity>()
			.WithMany()
			.HasForeignKey(v => v.AuthorId)
			.OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Restrict);
	}
}
```

- [ ] **Step 8: Create `CommentReportConfiguration`**

Create `src/web/MZikmund.Web.Data/Entities/Configurations/CommentReportConfiguration.cs`. The `(CommentId, ResolvedOn)` index serves the admin report queue, which filters on unresolved reports grouped by comment:

```csharp
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.Metadata.Builders;

namespace MZikmund.Web.Data.Entities.Configurations;

internal sealed class CommentReportConfiguration : IEntityTypeConfiguration<CommentReportEntity>
{
	public void Configure(EntityTypeBuilder<CommentReportEntity> builder)
	{
		builder.Property(r => r.Id).ValueGeneratedNever();
		builder.Property(r => r.Note).HasMaxLength(500);

		builder.HasIndex(r => new { r.CommentId, r.ResolvedOn });

		builder
			.HasOne<CommentEntity>()
			.WithMany()
			.HasForeignKey(r => r.CommentId)
			.OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Restrict);

		builder
			.HasOne<CommentAuthorEntity>()
			.WithMany()
			.HasForeignKey(r => r.ReporterId)
			.OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Restrict);
	}
}
```

### Task 3.4: The `Comments` EF migration

**Files:**
- Create (generated): `src/web/MZikmund.Web.Data/Migrations/{timestamp}_Comments.cs`
- Create (generated): `src/web/MZikmund.Web.Data/Migrations/{timestamp}_Comments.Designer.cs`
- Modify (generated): `src/web/MZikmund.Web.Data/Migrations/DatabaseContextModelSnapshot.cs`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: the model produced by Task 3.3 (`DatabaseContext` with the four DbSets and four applied configurations).
- Produces: SQL tables `Comment`, `CommentAuthor`, `CommentVote`, `CommentReport` with indexes `IX_Comment_AuthorId`, `IX_Comment_ParentId`, `IX_Comment_PostId_ParentId_CreatedOn`, `IX_CommentReport_CommentId_ResolvedOn`, `IX_CommentReport_ReporterId`, `IX_CommentVote_AuthorId`. `Program.cs` calls `context.Database.Migrate()` on startup, so this migration applies itself on the next run of the web app — including in production.

---

- [ ] **Step 1: Install the npm dependencies of the web project**

`MZikmund.Web.csproj` has `<Target Name="NpmBuild" BeforeTargets="Build"><Exec Command="npm run build" /></Target>`, and `dotnet ef` builds the startup project. Without this, the migration command fails with an npm error that looks nothing like an EF problem:

```bash
npm --prefix src/web/MZikmund.Web install
```

Expected output ends with a line like `added 123 packages in 8s` (or `up to date`).

10.0.3

```

- [ ] **Step 3: Point the design-time build at the Development environment**

`appsettings.json` has no `ConnectionStrings` section — only `appsettings.Development.json` does. Without this, `UseSqlServer(null)` throws while building the DbContext options.

(PowerShell equivalent: `$env:ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT = "Development"`.)

```

Use the Grep tool with pattern `name: "(Comment[A-Za-z]*|IX_Comment[A-Za-z_]*)"` over `src/web/MZikmund.Web.Data/Migrations/` (files matching `*_Comments.cs`), output mode `content`.

Expected to find exactly these ten names in the `Up` method — four `CreateTable` names and six `CreateIndex` names:

Also confirm every `ForeignKey` block in the file ends with `onDelete: ReferentialAction.Restrict` — *no* `ReferentialAction.Cascade` may appear. If any does, a configuration from Task 3.3 was not registered in `OnModelCreating`; fix that, run `dotnet ef migrations remove -p src/web/MZikmund.Web.Data -s src/web/MZikmund.Web`, and redo Step 4.

- [ ] **Step 6: Convert the migration file to the repo's file-scoped-namespace style**

Only `{timestamp}_Comments.cs` is reformatted. `.Designer.cs` and `DatabaseContextModelSnapshot.cs` carry `// <auto-generated />` and stay exactly as EF wrote them.

Replace the generated header, which looks like this:

```csharp
using System;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.Migrations;

#nullable disable

namespace MZikmund.Web.Data.Migrations
{
    /// <inheritdoc />
    public partial class Comments : Migration
    {
```

with this — file-scoped namespace, the `CA1861` suppression the composite `CreateIndex(columns: new[] { ... })` calls require (performance analyzers are error-level in this repo), and one fewer level of nesting:

```csharp
using System;
using System.Diagnostics.CodeAnalysis;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.Migrations;

#nullable disable

namespace MZikmund.Web.Data.Migrations;

/// <inheritdoc />
[SuppressMessage("Performance", "CA1861:Avoid constant arrays as arguments")]
public partial class Comments : Migration
{
```

Then delete the now-unmatched closing brace at the very end of the file (the file must end with the single `}` that closes the class), and de-indent the whole body by one level. This matches `20251124201119_BlobMetadata.cs` exactly. `dotnet format` in Step 9 converts the remaining spaces to tabs.

### Task 3.5: `CommentMap` AutoMapper profile

**Files:**
- Test: `src/web/MZikmund.Web.Core.Tests/Mappings/CommentMapTests.cs` (create)
- Create: `src/web/MZikmund.Web.Core/Mappings/CommentMap.cs`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: `MZikmund.Web.Data.Entities.CommentEntity` and `CommentAuthorEntity` (Task 3.2); `MZikmund.DataContracts.Blog.Comments.CommentDto` and `CommentStatus` (Task 3.1).
- Produces: `MZikmund.Web.Core.Mappings.CommentMap : Profile`, containing `CreateMap<CommentEntity, CommentDto>()`. Picked up automatically by the existing `services.AddAutoMapper(c => c.AddMaps(typeof(CoreAssemblyMarker)));` in `Program.cs` — **no DI change**. The map fills `Id`, `PostId`, `ParentId`, `MentionedDisplayName`, `Content`, `ContentHtml`, `Status`, `CreatedOn`, `EditedOn`, `UpvoteCount`, `ReplyCount` by name, and `AuthorDisplayName` / `AuthorAvatarUrl` from the `Author` navigation. It deliberately ignores `HasUpvoted`, `IsOwn` and `Replies`, which the Phase 4 query handlers hand-project because they are per-caller or bounded.

---

- [ ] **Step 1: Write the failing mapping test**

Create `src/web/MZikmund.Web.Core.Tests/Mappings/CommentMapTests.cs`. Both `MZikmund.Web.Data.Entities` and `MZikmund.DataContracts.Blog.Comments` declare a type named `CommentStatus`, so the file uses aliases rather than plain `using` directives for them. `MapperConfiguration` in AutoMapper 16.1.1 **requires** the `ILoggerFactory` argument. The profile is validated in isolation with `AddProfile<CommentMap>` — a whole-assembly `AddMaps(typeof(CoreAssemblyMarker))` validation would fail on pre-existing maps (`PostEntity → Post` leaves `IsPublished` unmapped) and tell you nothing about comments:

```csharp
using AutoMapper;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging.Abstractions;
using MZikmund.DataContracts.Blog.Comments;
using MZikmund.Web.Core.Mappings;
using MZikmund.Web.Data.Entities;
using DtoStatus = MZikmund.DataContracts.Blog.Comments.CommentStatus;
using EntityStatus = MZikmund.Web.Data.Entities.CommentStatus;

namespace MZikmund.Web.Core.Tests.Mappings;

public class CommentMapTests
{
	private static MapperConfiguration CreateConfiguration() =>
		new(cfg => cfg.AddProfile<CommentMap>(), NullLoggerFactory.Instance);

	private static CommentEntity CreateEntity() =>
		new()
		{
			Id = new Guid("11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111"),
			PostId = new Guid("22222222-2222-2222-2222-222222222222"),
			ParentId = new Guid("33333333-3333-3333-3333-333333333333"),
			AuthorId = new Guid("44444444-4444-4444-4444-444444444444"),
			Content = "Hello **world**",
			ContentHtml = "<p>Hello <strong>world</strong></p>",
			MentionedDisplayName = "Jane",
			Status = EntityStatus.HiddenByModerator,
			CreatedOn = new DateTime(2026, 8, 11, 10, 0, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc),
			EditedOn = new DateTime(2026, 8, 11, 10, 5, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc),
			UpvoteCount = 7,
			ReplyCount = 2,
			ReportCount = 1,
			Author = new CommentAuthorEntity
			{
				Id = new Guid("44444444-4444-4444-4444-444444444444"),
				DisplayName = "Martin",
				AvatarUrl = "https://example.com/avatar.png",
				Email = "martin@example.com",
			},
		};

	[Fact]
	public void Configuration_CommentProfile_IsValid()
	{
		// Arrange
		var configuration = CreateConfiguration();

		// Act
		var exception = Record.Exception(configuration.AssertConfigurationIsValid);

		// Assert
		Assert.Null(exception);
	}

	[Fact]
	public void Map_CommentEntity_CopiesScalarMembers()
	{
		// Arrange
		var mapper = CreateConfiguration().CreateMapper();
		var entity = CreateEntity();

		// Act
		var dto = mapper.Map<CommentDto>(entity);

		// Assert
		Assert.Equal(entity.Id, dto.Id);
		Assert.Equal(entity.PostId, dto.PostId);
		Assert.Equal(entity.ParentId, dto.ParentId);
		Assert.Equal("Hello **world**", dto.Content);
		Assert.Equal("<p>Hello <strong>world</strong></p>", dto.ContentHtml);
		Assert.Equal("Jane", dto.MentionedDisplayName);
		Assert.Equal(DtoStatus.HiddenByModerator, dto.Status);
		Assert.Equal(entity.CreatedOn, dto.CreatedOn);
		Assert.Equal(entity.EditedOn, dto.EditedOn);
		Assert.Equal(7, dto.UpvoteCount);
		Assert.Equal(2, dto.ReplyCount);
	}

	[Fact]
	public void Map_CommentEntity_FlattensAuthorDetails()
	{
		// Arrange
		var mapper = CreateConfiguration().CreateMapper();
		var entity = CreateEntity();

		// Act
		var dto = mapper.Map<CommentDto>(entity);

		// Assert
		Assert.Equal("Martin", dto.AuthorDisplayName);
		Assert.Equal("https://example.com/avatar.png", dto.AuthorAvatarUrl);
	}

	[Fact]
	public void Map_CommentEntity_LeavesCallerSpecificMembersAtDefaults()
	{
		// Arrange
		var mapper = CreateConfiguration().CreateMapper();
		var entity = CreateEntity();

		// Act
		var dto = mapper.Map<CommentDto>(entity);

		// Assert
		Assert.False(dto.HasUpvoted);
		Assert.False(dto.IsOwn);
		Assert.NotNull(dto.Replies);
		Assert.Empty(dto.Replies);
	}
}

- [ ] **Step 3: Create the `CommentMap` profile**

Create `src/web/MZikmund.Web.Core/Mappings/CommentMap.cs`. `Status` crosses between two same-shaped enums and AutoMapper converts it by value; the three ignored members are computed per caller and are hand-projected by `CommentProjection` in the Phase 5 query handlers:

```csharp
using AutoMapper;
using MZikmund.DataContracts.Blog.Comments;
using MZikmund.Web.Data.Entities;

namespace MZikmund.Web.Core.Mappings;

public class CommentMap : Profile
{
	public CommentMap()
	{
		CreateMap<CommentEntity, CommentDto>()
			.ForMember(dto => dto.AuthorDisplayName, opt => opt.MapFrom(entity => entity.Author.DisplayName))
			.ForMember(dto => dto.AuthorAvatarUrl, opt => opt.MapFrom(entity => entity.Author.AvatarUrl))
			// Per-caller and bounded members are hand-projected by the query handlers.
			.ForMember(dto => dto.HasUpvoted, opt => opt.Ignore())
			.ForMember(dto => dto.IsOwn, opt => opt.Ignore())
			.ForMember(dto => dto.Replies, opt => opt.Ignore());
	}
}
```

## Phase 4: Comment services — restricted markdown rendering, Turnstile verification, and the authored-request pipeline behavior

> **Deliberate deviations recorded here** (per the contract's "state these in the plan" rule):
> 1. `ICommentContentRenderer` deliberately does **not** reuse `IMarkdownConverter`; it builds its own Markdig pipeline and its own `HtmlSanitizer`. The reason is written into an XML doc comment on the class in Task 4.1, Step 5.
> 2. `TurnstileOptions` gains an `ExpectedAction` property beyond the two properties listed in the contract, because the contract's Turnstile enforcement predicate requires the `action` echo check. It is declared in Task 4.2's **Produces**.
> 3. `AuthoredRequestBehavior` signals failure with `UnauthorizedAccessException` (there is no exception→status mapping in this repo yet; the API phase maps it). Declared in Task 4.3's **Produces**.
> 4. `AuthoredRequestBehaviorTests` builds its own SQLite `DatabaseContext` inline instead of taking a dependency on `CommentsDbFixture`, because it only needs the `CommentAuthor` table and must not couple this phase to the fixture's shape.

Create `src/web/MZikmund.Web.Core/Services/Comments/CommentContentRenderer.cs`:

```csharp
using Ganss.Xss;
using Markdig;
using Markdig.Extensions.EmphasisExtras;
using Markdig.Renderers.Html;
using Markdig.Syntax;
using Markdig.Syntax.Inlines;

namespace MZikmund.Web.Core.Services.Comments;

/// <summary>
/// Renders user-authored comment markdown to sanitized HTML.
/// </summary>
/// <remarks>
/// This deliberately does NOT reuse <c>IMarkdownConverter</c>. That converter renders trusted,
/// admin-authored blog posts: its pipeline is permissive on purpose (raw HTML, media links,
/// generic attributes) and <c>PostContentProcessor</c> even injects raw gist &lt;script&gt; tags
/// before conversion. None of that is acceptable for user-generated content, and restricting the
/// shared converter would break the blog. Comments therefore get their own pipeline plus an
/// HtmlSanitizer allow-list that matches exactly what this pipeline can emit.
/// </remarks>
public sealed class CommentContentRenderer : ICommentContentRenderer
{
	// Markdig writes these into rel="..." on every anchor it emits.
	private static readonly string[] LinkRels = ["nofollow", "ugc", "noopener", "noreferrer"];

	// Exactly the tags the restricted pipeline can emit. Thematic breaks and indented code are
	// core CommonMark and cannot be turned off by an extension flag, hence hr/pre/code.
	private static readonly string[] AllowedHtmlTags =
	[
		"p", "br", "strong", "em", "del", "code", "pre",
		"blockquote", "ul", "ol", "li", "a", "hr"
	];

	// "class" is deliberately absent: fenced code emits class="language-<whatever the user typed>".
	private static readonly string[] AllowedHtmlAttributes = ["href", "title", "rel", "target"];

	private static readonly string[] AllowedUrlSchemes = ["http", "https", "mailto"];

	private readonly MarkdownPipeline _pipeline;
	private readonly HtmlSanitizer _sanitizer;

	public CommentContentRenderer()
	{
		var builder = new MarkdownPipelineBuilder()
			.DisableHtml()      // raw HTML blocks and inline tags are escaped, not parsed
			.DisableHeadings()  // no ATX or setext headings in comments
			.UseEmphasisExtras(EmphasisExtraOptions.Strikethrough)
			.UseReferralLinks(LinkRels);

		builder.DocumentProcessed += static document =>
		{
			foreach (var node in document.Descendants())
			{
				switch (node)
				{
					// Images become their alt text. An EMPTY literal plus copyChildren keeps the
					// label exactly once; a filled literal with copyChildren would duplicate it.
					case LinkInline { IsImage: true } image:
						image.ReplaceBy(new LiteralInline(), copyChildren: true);
						break;

					// Scheme filtering happens here as well as in the sanitizer: the sanitizer
					// alone would only strip the href and leave a link-styled anchor behind.
					case LinkInline link when !IsAllowedUrl(link.Url):
						link.ReplaceBy(new LiteralInline(), copyChildren: true);
						break;

					case LinkInline link:
						link.GetAttributes().AddPropertyIfNotExist("target", "_blank");
						break;

					// <https://...> autolinks are AutolinkInline, a different type from LinkInline.
					case AutolinkInline autolink when !IsAllowedUrl(autolink.Url):
						autolink.ReplaceBy(new LiteralInline(autolink.Url), copyChildren: false);
						break;

					case AutolinkInline autolink:
						autolink.GetAttributes().AddPropertyIfNotExist("target", "_blank");
						break;
				}
			}
		};

		_pipeline = builder.Build();

		// Every default set must be cleared first: the defaults allow 95+ tags (img, form, input,
		// button) and 100+ attributes (style, src, action).
		_sanitizer = new HtmlSanitizer();
		_sanitizer.AllowedTags.Clear();
		_sanitizer.AllowedTags.UnionWith(AllowedHtmlTags);
		_sanitizer.AllowedAttributes.Clear();
		_sanitizer.AllowedAttributes.UnionWith(AllowedHtmlAttributes);
		_sanitizer.AllowedCssProperties.Clear();
		_sanitizer.AllowedAtRules.Clear();
		_sanitizer.AllowedSchemes.Clear();
		_sanitizer.AllowedSchemes.UnionWith(AllowedUrlSchemes);
		_sanitizer.AllowDataAttributes = false;
		_sanitizer.KeepChildNodes = false;
	}

	public string RenderHtml(string markdown)
	{
		if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(markdown))
		{
			return string.Empty;
		}

		var html = Markdig.Markdown.ToHtml(markdown, _pipeline);
		return _sanitizer.Sanitize(html).Trim();
	}

	private static bool IsAllowedUrl(string? url)
	{
		if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(url))
		{
			return false;
		}

		if (!Uri.TryCreate(url, UriKind.RelativeOrAbsolute, out var uri))
		{
			return false;
		}

		return !uri.IsAbsoluteUri || AllowedUrlSchemes.Contains(uri.Scheme, StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
	}
}
```

namespace MZikmund.Web.Core.Services.Comments;

/// <summary>
/// Verifies a Cloudflare Turnstile token against the siteverify endpoint.
/// </summary>
public interface ITurnstileVerifier
{
	/// <summary>
	/// Verifies a Turnstile token. Fails closed: a token that cannot be checked did not pass.
	/// </summary>
	/// <param name="token">The client-side token from the CF-Turnstile-Response header.</param>
	/// <param name="remoteIp">The caller's IP address, or null when unknown.</param>
	/// <param name="cancellationToken">Cancellation token.</param>
	/// <returns><c>true</c> only when Cloudflare reports success and the action matches.</returns>
	Task<bool> VerifyAsync(string token, string? remoteIp, CancellationToken cancellationToken);
}
```

using System.Net;
using System.Text;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Options;
using Moq;
using MZikmund.Web.Configuration;
using MZikmund.Web.Core.Services.Comments;

namespace MZikmund.Web.Core.Tests.Services.Comments;

public class TurnstileVerifierTests
{
	private const string SuccessJson = """
		{
			"success": true,
			"challenge_ts": "2026-08-11T15:14:30.096Z",
			"hostname": "mzikmund.dev",
			"error-codes": [],
			"action": "comment-create"
		}
		""";

	private const string WrongActionJson = """
		{
			"success": true,
			"challenge_ts": "2026-08-11T15:14:30.096Z",
			"hostname": "mzikmund.dev",
			"error-codes": [],
			"action": "some-other-form"
		}
		""";

	private const string FailureJson = """
		{
			"success": false,
			"error-codes": ["invalid-input-response"]
		}
		""";

	private readonly TurnstileOptions _options = new()
	{
		SiteKey = "1x00000000000000000000AA",
		SecretKey = "test-secret",
		ExpectedAction = "comment-create"
	};

	private TurnstileVerifier CreateVerifier(FakeTurnstileHandler handler)
	{
		var httpClient = new HttpClient(handler);
		var mockFactory = new Mock<IHttpClientFactory>();
		mockFactory.Setup(f => f.CreateClient(TurnstileVerifier.HttpClientName)).Returns(httpClient);

		return new TurnstileVerifier(
			mockFactory.Object,
			Options.Create(_options),
			new Mock<ILogger<TurnstileVerifier>>().Object);
	}

	[Fact]
	public async Task VerifyAsync_WhenSiteverifyReportsFailure_ReturnsFalse()
	{
		// Arrange
		var handler = new FakeTurnstileHandler(FailureJson);
		var verifier = CreateVerifier(handler);

		// Act
		var result = await verifier.VerifyAsync("dummy-token", "203.0.113.7", CancellationToken.None);

		// Assert
		Assert.False(result);
	}

	[Fact]
	public async Task VerifyAsync_WhenSiteverifySucceedsWithMatchingAction_ReturnsTrue()
	{
		// Arrange
		var handler = new FakeTurnstileHandler(SuccessJson);
		var verifier = CreateVerifier(handler);

		// Act
		var result = await verifier.VerifyAsync("dummy-token", "203.0.113.7", CancellationToken.None);

		// Assert
		Assert.True(result);
	}

	[Fact]
	public async Task VerifyAsync_WhenActionDoesNotMatch_ReturnsFalse()
	{
		// Arrange
		var handler = new FakeTurnstileHandler(WrongActionJson);
		var verifier = CreateVerifier(handler);

		// Act
		var result = await verifier.VerifyAsync("dummy-token", null, CancellationToken.None);

		// Assert
		Assert.False(result);
	}

	[Fact]
	public async Task VerifyAsync_WithEmptyToken_ReturnsFalseWithoutCallingSiteverify()
	{
		// Arrange
		var handler = new FakeTurnstileHandler(SuccessJson);
		var verifier = CreateVerifier(handler);

		// Act
		var result = await verifier.VerifyAsync("", null, CancellationToken.None);

		// Assert
		Assert.False(result);
		Assert.Equal(0, handler.SendCount);
	}

	[Fact]
	public async Task VerifyAsync_WhenTransportFails_ReturnsFalse()
	{
		// Arrange
		var handler = new FakeTurnstileHandler(SuccessJson, throwOnSend: true);
		var verifier = CreateVerifier(handler);

		// Act
		var result = await verifier.VerifyAsync("dummy-token", null, CancellationToken.None);

		// Assert
		Assert.False(result);
	}

	[Fact]
	public async Task VerifyAsync_PostsSecretAndResponseToSiteverifyEndpoint()
	{
		// Arrange
		var handler = new FakeTurnstileHandler(SuccessJson);
		var verifier = CreateVerifier(handler);

		// Act
		await verifier.VerifyAsync("dummy-token", "203.0.113.7", CancellationToken.None);

		// Assert
		Assert.Equal(
			"https://challenges.cloudflare.com/turnstile/v0/siteverify",
			handler.RequestUri!.ToString());
		Assert.Contains("secret=test-secret", handler.RequestBody);
		Assert.Contains("response=dummy-token", handler.RequestBody);
		Assert.Contains("remoteip=203.0.113.7", handler.RequestBody);
	}

	private sealed class FakeTurnstileHandler : HttpMessageHandler
	{
		private readonly string _responseJson;
		private readonly HttpStatusCode _statusCode;
		private readonly bool _throwOnSend;

		public FakeTurnstileHandler(
			string responseJson,
			HttpStatusCode statusCode = HttpStatusCode.OK,
			bool throwOnSend = false)
		{
			_responseJson = responseJson;
			_statusCode = statusCode;
			_throwOnSend = throwOnSend;
		}

		public int SendCount { get; private set; }

		public Uri? RequestUri { get; private set; }

		public string RequestBody { get; private set; } = "";

		protected override async Task<HttpResponseMessage> SendAsync(HttpRequestMessage request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			SendCount++;
			RequestUri = request.RequestUri;

			if (request.Content is not null)
			{
				RequestBody = await request.Content.ReadAsStringAsync(cancellationToken);
			}

			if (_throwOnSend)
			{
				throw new HttpRequestException("Simulated network failure.");
			}

			return new HttpResponseMessage(_statusCode)
			{
				Content = new StringContent(_responseJson, Encoding.UTF8, "application/json")
			};
		}
	}
}

/// <summary>
/// Shape of the Cloudflare siteverify response. Wire names are hyphenated / snake_cased,
/// so the JsonPropertyName attributes cannot be replaced by a naming policy.

	[JsonPropertyName("challenge_ts")]
	public DateTimeOffset? ChallengeTimestamp { get; set; }

	public string[]? ErrorCodes { get; set; }

	[JsonPropertyName("action")]

Create `src/web/MZikmund.Web.Core/Services/Comments/TurnstileVerifier.cs`:

```csharp
using System.Net.Http.Json;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Options;
using MZikmund.Web.Configuration;

namespace MZikmund.Web.Core.Services.Comments;

/// <summary>
/// Verifies Turnstile tokens against Cloudflare's siteverify endpoint.
/// </summary>
public sealed class TurnstileVerifier : ITurnstileVerifier
{
	/// <summary>
	/// Name of the named HttpClient registered in Program.cs.
	/// </summary>
	public const string HttpClientName = "Turnstile";

	private const string SiteVerifyUrl = "https://challenges.cloudflare.com/turnstile/v0/siteverify";

	// Cloudflare caps the token at 2048 characters.
	private const int MaxTokenLength = 2048;

	private readonly IHttpClientFactory _httpClientFactory;
	private readonly TurnstileOptions _options;
	private readonly ILogger<TurnstileVerifier> _logger;

	public TurnstileVerifier(
		IHttpClientFactory httpClientFactory,
		IOptions<TurnstileOptions> options,
		ILogger<TurnstileVerifier> logger)
	{
		_httpClientFactory = httpClientFactory;
		_options = options.Value;
		_logger = logger;
	}

	public async Task<bool> VerifyAsync(string token, string? remoteIp, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
	{
		if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(token) || token.Length > MaxTokenLength)
		{
			_logger.LogWarning("Turnstile token missing or oversized.");
			return false;
		}

		var fields = new Dictionary<string, string>
		{
			["secret"] = _options.SecretKey,
			["response"] = token,
			// One key per logical verification. If a retry loop is ever added, every attempt must
			// reuse THIS value or Cloudflare counts the token as replayed.
			["idempotency_key"] = Guid.NewGuid().ToString()
		};

		if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(remoteIp))
		{
			fields["remoteip"] = remoteIp;
		}

		try
		{
			var httpClient = _httpClientFactory.CreateClient(HttpClientName);
			using var content = new FormUrlEncodedContent(fields);
			using var response = await httpClient.PostAsync(SiteVerifyUrl, content, cancellationToken);
			response.EnsureSuccessStatusCode();

			var result = await response.Content.ReadFromJsonAsync<TurnstileSiteVerifyResponse>(cancellationToken);

			if (result is null)
			{
				_logger.LogWarning("Turnstile siteverify returned an empty body.");
				return false;
			}

			if (!result.Success)
			{
				_logger.LogWarning(
					"Turnstile verification failed: {ErrorCodes}",
					string.Join(", ", result.ErrorCodes ?? []));
				return false;
			}

			// Cloudflare echoes `action` back but does not enforce it, so we must.
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(_options.ExpectedAction) &&
				!string.Equals(result.Action, _options.ExpectedAction, StringComparison.Ordinal))
			{
				_logger.LogWarning(
					"Turnstile action mismatch. Expected {Expected}, got {Actual}.",
					_options.ExpectedAction,
					result.Action);
				return false;
			}

			return true;
		}
		catch (Exception ex) when (ex is HttpRequestException or TaskCanceledException)
		{
			// Fail closed: a captcha we cannot check is a captcha that did not pass.
			_logger.LogError(ex, "Turnstile siteverify request failed.");
			return false;
		}
	}
}
```

- [ ] **Step 6: Implement the pipeline behavior**

Create `src/web/MZikmund.Web.Core/Infrastructure/AuthoredRequestBehavior.cs`:

```csharp
using MediatR;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using MZikmund.Web.Core.Services;
using MZikmund.Web.Core.Services.Comments;
using MZikmund.Web.Data;
using MZikmund.Web.Data.Entities;

namespace MZikmund.Web.Core.Infrastructure;

/// <summary>
/// Upserts the comment author row from the authenticated caller's claims and rejects banned
/// authors, for every request marked with <see cref="IAuthoredRequest"/>.
/// </summary>
/// <remarks>
/// Registered as an open behavior. The generic constraint is honoured by the built-in DI container,
/// which skips open generic implementations whose constraints a request type does not satisfy, so
/// unmarked requests never see this behavior.
/// </remarks>
public sealed class AuthoredRequestBehavior<TRequest, TResponse> : IPipelineBehavior<TRequest, TResponse>
	where TRequest : IAuthoredRequest
{
	private readonly DatabaseContext _dbContext;
	private readonly ICurrentUserAccessor _currentUserAccessor;
	private readonly IDateProvider _dateProvider;
	private readonly ILogger<AuthoredRequestBehavior<TRequest, TResponse>> _logger;

	public AuthoredRequestBehavior(
		DatabaseContext dbContext,
		ICurrentUserAccessor currentUserAccessor,
		IDateProvider dateProvider,
		ILogger<AuthoredRequestBehavior<TRequest, TResponse>> logger)
	{
		_dbContext = dbContext;
		_currentUserAccessor = currentUserAccessor;
		_dateProvider = dateProvider;
		_logger = logger;
	}

	public async Task<TResponse> Handle(
		TRequest request,
		RequestHandlerDelegate<TResponse> next,
		CancellationToken cancellationToken)
	{
		var current = _currentUserAccessor.Current;
		if (current is null)
		{
			throw new UnauthorizedAccessException(
				$"{typeof(TRequest).Name} requires an authenticated author.");
		}

		var now = _dateProvider.UtcNow.UtcDateTime;

		var author = await _dbContext.CommentAuthor
			.FirstOrDefaultAsync(a => a.Id == current.Id, cancellationToken);

		if (author is null)
		{
			author = new CommentAuthorEntity
			{
				Id = current.Id,
				CreatedOn = now,
				NotifyOnReply = true
			};

			_dbContext.CommentAuthor.Add(author);
			_logger.LogInformation("Creating comment author projection for {AuthorId}.", current.Id);
		}
		else if (author.IsBanned)
		{
			// Bans block future writes only; existing comments stay visible.
			throw new UnauthorizedAccessException($"Author {current.Id} is banned.");
		}

		author.DisplayName = current.DisplayName;
		author.AvatarUrl = current.AvatarUrl;
		author.Email = current.Email;
		author.LastSeenOn = now;

		await _dbContext.SaveChangesAsync(cancellationToken);

		return await next(cancellationToken);
	}
}

## Phase 5: Comment read handlers and shared projection helpers

This half of Phase 5 builds everything the read path needs: the shared size limits, the shared
projection helper (`CommentRow` + `CommentProjection`), and the two anonymous read handlers
(`GetPostCommentsHandler`, `GetCommentRepliesHandler`). The write commands
(`CreateCommentCommand`, `UpdateCommentCommand`, `DeleteCommentCommand`, `SetCommentVoteCommand`,
`ReportCommentCommand`) and the Phase 5 gate task continue in the second half of Phase 5.

**Prerequisites already produced by earlier phases** — every task below consumes them and none
recreates them:

- Phase 0 Task 0.7: `MZikmund.Web.Core.Tests.Infrastructure.CommentsDbFixture` with
  `public DatabaseContext CreateContext()`. One fixture instance = ONE SQLite database shared by
  every context it hands out, so each test below seeds and asserts through a **single**
  `CreateContext()` and scopes its rows with a freshly generated `PostId` so sibling tests in the
  same class can never collide (audit item 1.7).
- Phase 1 Task 1.4: `MZikmund.Web.Core.Services.Comments.ICurrentUserAccessor` and
  `CommentAuthorInfo(Guid Id, string DisplayName, string? AvatarUrl, string Email, bool IsAdmin)`.
- Phase 3: `CommentEntity`, `CommentAuthorEntity`, `CommentVoteEntity`,
  `MZikmund.Web.Data.Entities.CommentStatus`, the `Comment` / `CommentAuthor` / `CommentVote`
  DbSets on `DatabaseContext`, and the DTOs `CommentDto`, `CommentSortOrder` and
  `MZikmund.DataContracts.Blog.Comments.CommentStatus`.

**Two corrections against the audit, made after checking the real files (the real file wins):**

1. Audit item 6.3 says `InternalsVisibleTo` arrives one phase too late. The grant **already exists
   in the repo today** at `src/web/MZikmund.Web.Core/Properties/AssemblyInfo.cs`
   (`[assembly: InternalsVisibleTo("MZikmund.Web.Core.Tests")]`). Task 5.1 therefore *renames* that
   file to `Properties/InternalsVisibleTo.cs` rather than adding a second declaration. **Phase 6
   Task 6.1 Step 1 must be deleted** — creating the file again there would duplicate the attribute.
2. Audit item 3.2 requires `CommentLimits` to be the single source of truth including for the Uno
   app (Phase 10 must not declare its own `MaxCommentLength`). `MZikmund.App.Core` cannot reference
   `MZikmund.Web.Core`, so `CommentLimits` lives in `MZikmund.DataContracts.Blog.Comments`, which
   both the web handlers and the app already reference. **No other phase may declare it.**

**Read visibility rule produced here and relied on by every later phase:** public reads exclude
`CommentStatus.HiddenByModerator` (from `Data`, `TotalCount` and inline replies alike);
`DeletedByAuthor` rows are returned so the client can render a tombstone.

### Task 5.2: `CommentRow` and the shared `CommentProjection` helper

**Files:**
- Create: `src/web/MZikmund.Web.Core/Features/Comments/CommentRow.cs`
- Create: `src/web/MZikmund.Web.Core/Features/Comments/CommentProjection.cs`
- Test: `src/web/MZikmund.Web.Core.Tests/Features/Comments/CommentProjectionTests.cs`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes:
  ```csharp
  // Phase 3 entities
  MZikmund.Web.Data.Entities.CommentEntity          // Id, PostId, ParentId, AuthorId, Content, ContentHtml,
                                                    // MentionedDisplayName, Status, CreatedOn, EditedOn,
                                                    // UpvoteCount, ReplyCount, Author, Votes
  MZikmund.Web.Data.Entities.CommentAuthorEntity    // Id, DisplayName, AvatarUrl, Email, CreatedOn, LastSeenOn
  MZikmund.Web.Data.Entities.CommentVoteEntity      // CommentId, AuthorId, CreatedOn
  MZikmund.Web.Data.Entities.CommentStatus          // Visible, DeletedByAuthor, HiddenByModerator
  // Phase 3 DTOs
  MZikmund.DataContracts.Blog.Comments.CommentDto
  MZikmund.DataContracts.Blog.Comments.CommentStatus
  // Phase 0 test fixture
  MZikmund.Web.Core.Tests.Infrastructure.CommentsDbFixture.CreateContext() // returns DatabaseContext
  ```
- Produces:
  ```csharp
  namespace MZikmund.Web.Core.Features.Comments;

  internal sealed record CommentRow(
  	Guid Id, Guid PostId, Guid? ParentId, string AuthorDisplayName, string? AuthorAvatarUrl,
  	string? MentionedDisplayName, string Content, string ContentHtml,
  	MZikmund.Web.Data.Entities.CommentStatus Status, DateTime CreatedOn, DateTime? EditedOn,
  	int UpvoteCount, int ReplyCount, bool HasUpvoted, bool IsOwn);

  internal static class CommentProjection
  {
  	public const int InlineReplyCount = 3;
  	public static IQueryable<CommentEntity> Visible(IQueryable<CommentEntity> comments);
  	public static IQueryable<CommentRow> SelectRows(IQueryable<CommentEntity> comments, Guid? currentAuthorId);
  	public static Task<Dictionary<Guid, CommentDto[]>> LoadInlineRepliesAsync(
  		IQueryable<CommentEntity> comments, IReadOnlyList<Guid> parentIds, Guid? currentAuthorId,
  		CancellationToken cancellationToken);
  	// BOTH ToDto overloads are part of the contract and MUST both exist:
  	public static CommentDto ToDto(CommentRow row, CommentDto[]? replies = null);
  	public static CommentDto ToDto(CommentEntity comment, Guid? currentAuthorId, bool includeReplies);
  }
  ```
  `LoadInlineRepliesAsync` returns a dictionary containing an entry for **every** id in `parentIds`
  (empty array when a parent has no visible replies), so callers may index it directly.

  The two `ToDto` overloads serve different call sites and neither may be dropped:
  - `ToDto(CommentRow, CommentDto[]?)` is the read path — it maps an already-projected flat row and
    is used by Tasks 5.3 and 5.4.
  - `ToDto(CommentEntity, Guid?, bool)` is the write path — it maps a **tracked** `CommentEntity`
    (with its `Author` navigation loaded), computes `HasUpvoted` from `comment.Votes` against
    `currentAuthorId`, computes `IsOwn` as `currentAuthorId == comment.AuthorId`, and returns
    `Replies = Array.Empty<CommentDto>()` when `includeReplies` is `false`. The write handlers in
    the second half of Phase 5 (`CreateCommentHandler`, `UpdateCommentHandler`,
    `SetCommentVoteHandler`) call exactly this signature.

	[Fact]
	public async Task SelectRows_ForVotingAuthor_SetsHasUpvotedAndIsOwn()
	{
		// Arrange
		using var context = _fixture.CreateContext();
		var postId = Guid.NewGuid();
		var authorId = Guid.NewGuid();
		SeedPost(context, postId);
		SeedAuthor(context, authorId, "Marge");
		var comment = SeedComment(context, postId, authorId, "hello", Day(1), upvoteCount: 1);
		context.CommentVote.Add(new CommentVoteEntity
		{
			CommentId = comment.Id,
			AuthorId = authorId,
			CreatedOn = Day(1),
		});
		await context.SaveChangesAsync(CancellationToken.None);

		// Act
		var rows = await CommentProjection
			.SelectRows(context.Comment.Where(c => c.PostId == postId), authorId)
			.ToArrayAsync(CancellationToken.None);

		Assert.True(row.HasUpvoted);
		Assert.True(row.IsOwn);
