```csharp
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using MZikmund.DataContracts.Blog.Comments;
using MZikmund.Web.Data.Entities;
using DataCommentStatus = MZikmund.Web.Data.Entities.CommentStatus;
using DtoCommentStatus = MZikmund.DataContracts.Blog.Comments.CommentStatus;

namespace MZikmund.Web.Core.Features.Comments;

/// <summary>
/// Shared projection turning comment rows into DTOs, including the per-caller flags AutoMapper
/// cannot produce and the bounded inline reply set.
/// </summary>
internal static class CommentProjection
{
	/// <summary>
	/// Number of replies embedded directly in a comment.
	/// </summary>
	public const int InlineReplyCount = 3;

	/// <summary>
	/// Restricts a comment query to what the public may read.
	/// </summary>
	public static IQueryable<CommentEntity> Visible(IQueryable<CommentEntity> comments) =>
		comments.Where(comment => comment.Status != DataCommentStatus.HiddenByModerator);

	/// <summary>
	/// Projects comments into flat rows, resolving the vote and ownership flags for the caller.
	/// </summary>
	public static IQueryable<CommentRow> SelectRows(IQueryable<CommentEntity> comments, Guid? currentAuthorId) =>
		comments.Select(comment => new CommentRow(
			comment.Id,
			comment.PostId,
			comment.ParentId,
			comment.Author.DisplayName,
			comment.Author.AvatarUrl,
			comment.MentionedDisplayName,
			comment.Content,
			comment.ContentHtml,
			comment.Status,
			comment.CreatedOn,
			comment.EditedOn,
			comment.UpvoteCount,
			comment.ReplyCount,
			currentAuthorId != null && comment.Votes.Any(vote => vote.AuthorId == currentAuthorId),
			currentAuthorId != null && comment.AuthorId == currentAuthorId));

	/// <summary>
	/// Loads the first <see cref="InlineReplyCount"/> visible replies of each parent, CreatedOn
	/// ascending. Every requested parent gets an entry, empty when it has no visible replies.
	/// </summary>
	public static async Task<Dictionary<Guid, CommentDto[]>> LoadInlineRepliesAsync(
		IQueryable<CommentEntity> comments,
		IReadOnlyList<Guid> parentIds,
		Guid? currentAuthorId,
		CancellationToken cancellationToken)
	{
		Dictionary<Guid, CommentDto[]> repliesByParentId = new();

		// One small query per parent: a correlated Take is not translatable on every provider.
		foreach (var parentId in parentIds)
		{
			var rows = await SelectRows(
				Visible(comments)
					.Where(comment => comment.ParentId == parentId)
					.OrderBy(comment => comment.CreatedOn)
					.Take(InlineReplyCount),
				currentAuthorId)
				.ToArrayAsync(cancellationToken);

			repliesByParentId[parentId] = rows.Select(row => ToDto(row)).ToArray();
		}

		return repliesByParentId;
	}

	/// <summary>
	/// Converts a row into its DTO, optionally carrying already-loaded replies.
	/// </summary>
	public static CommentDto ToDto(CommentRow row, CommentDto[]? replies = null) => new()
	{
		Id = row.Id,
		PostId = row.PostId,
		ParentId = row.ParentId,
		AuthorDisplayName = row.AuthorDisplayName,
		AuthorAvatarUrl = row.AuthorAvatarUrl,
		MentionedDisplayName = row.MentionedDisplayName,
		Content = row.Content,
		ContentHtml = row.ContentHtml,
		Status = row.Status switch
		{
			DataCommentStatus.DeletedByAuthor => DtoCommentStatus.DeletedByAuthor,
			DataCommentStatus.HiddenByModerator => DtoCommentStatus.HiddenByModerator,
			_ => DtoCommentStatus.Visible,
		},
		CreatedOn = row.CreatedOn,
		EditedOn = row.EditedOn,
		UpvoteCount = row.UpvoteCount,
		ReplyCount = row.ReplyCount,
		HasUpvoted = row.HasUpvoted,
		IsOwn = row.IsOwn,
		Replies = replies ?? Array.Empty<CommentDto>(),
	};

	/// <summary>
	/// Converts a tracked entity into its DTO, resolving the caller's vote and ownership flags from
	/// the loaded navigations. Used by the write handlers, which already hold the entity.
	/// </summary>
	/// <param name="comment">Entity with its <see cref="CommentEntity.Author"/> navigation loaded.</param>
	/// <param name="currentAuthorId">Author the flags are resolved for, or <c>null</c> when anonymous.</param>
	/// <param name="includeReplies">When <c>false</c>, <see cref="CommentDto.Replies"/> is empty.</param>
	public static CommentDto ToDto(CommentEntity comment, Guid? currentAuthorId, bool includeReplies) => new()
	{
		Id = comment.Id,
		PostId = comment.PostId,
		ParentId = comment.ParentId,
		AuthorDisplayName = comment.Author.DisplayName,
		AuthorAvatarUrl = comment.Author.AvatarUrl,
		MentionedDisplayName = comment.MentionedDisplayName,
		Content = comment.Content,
		ContentHtml = comment.ContentHtml,
		Status = comment.Status switch
		{
			DataCommentStatus.DeletedByAuthor => DtoCommentStatus.DeletedByAuthor,
			DataCommentStatus.HiddenByModerator => DtoCommentStatus.HiddenByModerator,
			_ => DtoCommentStatus.Visible,
		},
		CreatedOn = comment.CreatedOn,
		EditedOn = comment.EditedOn,
		UpvoteCount = comment.UpvoteCount,
		ReplyCount = comment.ReplyCount,
		HasUpvoted = currentAuthorId is not null && comment.Votes.Any(vote => vote.AuthorId == currentAuthorId),
		IsOwn = currentAuthorId is not null && currentAuthorId == comment.AuthorId,
		Replies = includeReplies
			? comment.Replies
				.Where(reply => reply.Status != DataCommentStatus.HiddenByModerator)
				.OrderBy(reply => reply.CreatedOn)
				.Take(InlineReplyCount)
				.Select(reply => ToDto(reply, currentAuthorId, includeReplies: false))
				.ToArray()
			: Array.Empty<CommentDto>(),
	};
}
```

  Behaviour later phases rely on: `Data` holds top-level comments only; `TotalCount` is the count of
  visible top-level comments; `Sort == Top` orders by `UpvoteCount` descending then `CreatedOn`

  with the untruncated total in `ReplyCount`; `HasUpvoted`/`IsOwn` are resolved for

```csharp
		if (request.PageNumber < 1)
		{
			throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(request.PageNumber), "Page number must be at least 1.");
		}

		if (request.PageSize < 1)
		{
			throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(request.PageSize), "Page size must be at least 1.");
		}

		var currentAuthorId = _currentUserAccessor.Current?.Id;

		var topLevel = CommentProjection.Visible(_dbContext.Comment)
			.Where(comment => comment.PostId == request.PostId && comment.ParentId == null);

		var totalCount = await topLevel.CountAsync(cancellationToken);

		IOrderedQueryable<CommentEntity> ordered = request.Sort == CommentSortOrder.Top
			? topLevel.OrderByDescending(comment => comment.UpvoteCount).ThenBy(comment => comment.CreatedOn)
			: topLevel.OrderByDescending(comment => comment.CreatedOn);

		var rows = await CommentProjection.SelectRows(
			ordered
				.Skip((request.PageNumber - 1) * request.PageSize)
				.Take(request.PageSize),
			currentAuthorId)
			.ToArrayAsync(cancellationToken);

		var repliesByParentId = await CommentProjection.LoadInlineRepliesAsync(
			_dbContext.Comment,
			rows.Select(row => row.Id).ToArray(),
			currentAuthorId,
			cancellationToken);

		var comments = rows
			.Select(row => CommentProjection.ToDto(row, repliesByParentId[row.Id]))
			.ToArray();

		return new PagedResponse<CommentDto>(comments, request.PageNumber, request.PageSize, totalCount);
	}
}
```

- [ ] **Step 5: Implement the handler**

Replace the whole of `src/web/MZikmund.Web.Core/Features/Comments/GetCommentRepliesHandler.cs` with:

```csharp
using MediatR;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using MZikmund.DataContracts;
using MZikmund.DataContracts.Blog.Comments;
using MZikmund.Web.Core.Services.Comments;
using MZikmund.Web.Data;

namespace MZikmund.Web.Core.Features.Comments;

internal sealed class GetCommentRepliesHandler : IRequestHandler<GetCommentRepliesQuery, PagedResponse<CommentDto>>
{
	private readonly DatabaseContext _dbContext;
	private readonly ICurrentUserAccessor _currentUserAccessor;

	public GetCommentRepliesHandler(DatabaseContext dbContext, ICurrentUserAccessor currentUserAccessor)
	{
		_dbContext = dbContext;
		_currentUserAccessor = currentUserAccessor;
	}

	public async Task<PagedResponse<CommentDto>> Handle(GetCommentRepliesQuery request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
	{
		if (request.PageNumber < 1)
		{
			throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(request.PageNumber), "Page number must be at least 1.");
		}

		if (request.PageSize < 1)
		{
			throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(request.PageSize), "Page size must be at least 1.");
		}

		var currentAuthorId = _currentUserAccessor.Current?.Id;

		var replies = CommentProjection.Visible(_dbContext.Comment)
			.Where(comment => comment.ParentId == request.CommentId);

		var totalCount = await replies.CountAsync(cancellationToken);

		var rows = await CommentProjection.SelectRows(
			replies
				.OrderBy(comment => comment.CreatedOn)
				.Skip((request.PageNumber - 1) * request.PageSize)
				.Take(request.PageSize),
			currentAuthorId)
			.ToArrayAsync(cancellationToken);

		var comments = rows.Select(row => CommentProjection.ToDto(row)).ToArray();

		return new PagedResponse<CommentDto>(comments, request.PageNumber, request.PageSize, totalCount);
	}
}
```

  - `internal sealed class CreateCommentHandler : IRequestHandler<CreateCommentCommand, CommentDto>` with the constructor
    `CreateCommentHandler(DatabaseContext, ICurrentUserAccessor, ICommentContentRenderer, IDateProvider, ILogger<CreateCommentHandler>)`

Behavioural contract this task pins down, in the words of the spec:

- One level of threading is enforced **in the handler**. A reply whose target already has a parent is
  re-pointed at the **grandparent**, and the display name of the comment it was actually aimed at is
  stored in `MentionedDisplayName`.
- `Content` is stored **exactly as authored** (trimmed of surrounding whitespace, nothing else). The
  mention is **never** prefixed into `Content` — that is what keeps the edit round-trip from
  double-prefixing and keeps the 4000-character cap honest.
- The parent's `ReplyCount` is incremented in the **same transaction** as the insert.

```csharp
using MediatR;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using MZikmund.DataContracts.Blog.Comments;
using MZikmund.Web.Core.Services;
using MZikmund.Web.Core.Services.Comments;
using MZikmund.Web.Data;
using MZikmund.Web.Data.Entities;

namespace MZikmund.Web.Core.Features.Comments;

internal sealed class CreateCommentHandler : IRequestHandler<CreateCommentCommand, CommentDto>
{
	private readonly DatabaseContext _dbContext;
	private readonly ICurrentUserAccessor _currentUserAccessor;
	private readonly ICommentContentRenderer _contentRenderer;
	private readonly IDateProvider _dateProvider;
	private readonly ILogger<CreateCommentHandler> _logger;

	public CreateCommentHandler(
		DatabaseContext dbContext,
		ICurrentUserAccessor currentUserAccessor,
		ICommentContentRenderer contentRenderer,
		IDateProvider dateProvider,
		ILogger<CreateCommentHandler> logger)
	{
		_dbContext = dbContext;
		_currentUserAccessor = currentUserAccessor;
		_contentRenderer = contentRenderer;
		_dateProvider = dateProvider;
		_logger = logger;
	}

	public async Task<CommentDto> Handle(CreateCommentCommand request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
	{
		var author = _currentUserAccessor.Current
			?? throw new UnauthorizedAccessException("A signed-in author is required to create a comment.");

		var content = request.Content.Trim();
		if (content.Length == 0)
		{
			throw new ArgumentException("Comment content must not be empty.", nameof(request));
		}

		if (content.Length > CommentLimits.MaxCommentLength)
		{
			throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(
				nameof(request),
				$"Comment content must not exceed {CommentLimits.MaxCommentLength} characters.");
		}

		var postExists = await _dbContext.Post
			.AsNoTracking()
			.AnyAsync(p => p.Id == request.PostId, cancellationToken);
		if (!postExists)
		{
			throw new KeyNotFoundException($"Post {request.PostId} was not found.");
		}

		var authorEntity = await _dbContext.CommentAuthor
			.FirstOrDefaultAsync(a => a.Id == author.Id, cancellationToken)
			?? throw new KeyNotFoundException($"Comment author {author.Id} was not found.");

		CommentEntity? parent = null;
		string? mentionedDisplayName = null;

		if (request.ParentId is Guid targetId)
		{
			var target = await _dbContext.Comment
				.FirstOrDefaultAsync(c => c.Id == targetId, cancellationToken)
				?? throw new KeyNotFoundException($"Comment {targetId} was not found.");

			if (target.PostId != request.PostId)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException($"Comment {targetId} does not belong to post {request.PostId}.");
			}

			if (target.ParentId is Guid grandParentId)
			{
				// One level of threading only. A reply aimed at a reply is re-pointed at the
				// grandparent and attributed to the comment it actually targeted. The mention is a
				// column, never a prefix inside Content.
				parent = await _dbContext.Comment
					.FirstOrDefaultAsync(c => c.Id == grandParentId, cancellationToken)
					?? throw new KeyNotFoundException($"Comment {grandParentId} was not found.");

				mentionedDisplayName = await _dbContext.CommentAuthor
					.AsNoTracking()
					.Where(a => a.Id == target.AuthorId)
					.Select(a => a.DisplayName)
					.FirstOrDefaultAsync(cancellationToken);
			}
			else
			{
				parent = target;
			}
		}

		var now = _dateProvider.UtcNow.UtcDateTime;
		var comment = new CommentEntity
		{
			Id = Guid.NewGuid(),
			PostId = request.PostId,
			ParentId = parent?.Id,
			AuthorId = authorEntity.Id,
			Author = authorEntity,
			Content = content,
			ContentHtml = _contentRenderer.RenderHtml(content),
			MentionedDisplayName = mentionedDisplayName,
			Status = MZikmund.Web.Data.Entities.CommentStatus.Visible,
			CreatedOn = now,
			EditedOn = null,
			UpvoteCount = 0,
			ReplyCount = 0,
			ReportCount = 0,
		};

		var strategy = _dbContext.Database.CreateExecutionStrategy();
		await strategy.ExecuteAsync(
			async ct =>
			{
				await using var transaction = await _dbContext.Database.BeginTransactionAsync(ct);
				_dbContext.Comment.Add(comment);
				if (parent is not null)
				{
					parent.ReplyCount += 1;
				}

				await _dbContext.SaveChangesAsync(ct);
				await transaction.CommitAsync(ct);
			},
			cancellationToken);

		_logger.LogInformation(
			"Comment {CommentId} created on post {PostId} by author {AuthorId}.",
			comment.Id,
			comment.PostId,
			authorEntity.Id);

		return CommentProjection.ToDto(comment, author.Id, includeReplies: false);
	}
}
```

### Task 5.6: `UpdateCommentCommand` / `UpdateCommentHandler`

**Files:**
- Create: `src/web/MZikmund.Web.Core/Features/Comments/UpdateCommentCommand.cs`
- Create: `src/web/MZikmund.Web.Core/Features/Comments/UpdateCommentHandler.cs`
- Test: `src/web/MZikmund.Web.Core.Tests/Features/Comments/UpdateCommentHandlerTests.cs`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: `MZikmund.DataContracts.Blog.Comments.CommentLimits.MaxCommentLength` (Task 5.1); `CommentProjection.ToDto(CommentEntity, Guid?, bool)` (Task 5.2 — which also defines a second overload `ToDto(CommentRow, CommentDto[]?)` used by the read handlers, not here); `ICurrentUserAccessor`, `CommentAuthorInfo`, `ICommentContentRenderer`, `IDateProvider`, `IAuthoredRequest`, `DatabaseContext`, `CommentsDbFixture` (all as in Task 5.5)
- Produces:
  - `public record UpdateCommentCommand(Guid CommentId, string Content) : IRequest<CommentDto>, IAuthoredRequest;`
  - `internal sealed class UpdateCommentHandler : IRequestHandler<UpdateCommentCommand, CommentDto>` with the constructor
    `UpdateCommentHandler(DatabaseContext, ICurrentUserAccessor, ICommentContentRenderer, IDateProvider, ILogger<UpdateCommentHandler>)`

Rules pinned here: the 15-minute window is measured with `IDateProvider` (never `DateTime.UtcNow`);
only the author's own comment may be edited; `ContentHtml` is re-rendered; `MentionedDisplayName` and
`ParentId` are **never** re-derived — re-pointing is decided once, at creation. This handler writes a
single row and therefore deliberately has **no** explicit transaction (see the Task 5.10 gate).

```csharp
using MediatR;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using MZikmund.DataContracts.Blog.Comments;
using MZikmund.Web.Core.Services;
using MZikmund.Web.Core.Services.Comments;
using MZikmund.Web.Data;

namespace MZikmund.Web.Core.Features.Comments;

internal sealed class UpdateCommentHandler : IRequestHandler<UpdateCommentCommand, CommentDto>
{
	private static readonly TimeSpan EditWindow = TimeSpan.FromMinutes(15);

	private readonly DatabaseContext _dbContext;
	private readonly ICurrentUserAccessor _currentUserAccessor;
	private readonly ICommentContentRenderer _contentRenderer;
	private readonly IDateProvider _dateProvider;
	private readonly ILogger<UpdateCommentHandler> _logger;

	public UpdateCommentHandler(
		DatabaseContext dbContext,
		ICurrentUserAccessor currentUserAccessor,
		ICommentContentRenderer contentRenderer,
		IDateProvider dateProvider,
		ILogger<UpdateCommentHandler> logger)
	{
		_dbContext = dbContext;
		_currentUserAccessor = currentUserAccessor;
		_contentRenderer = contentRenderer;
		_dateProvider = dateProvider;
		_logger = logger;
	}

	public async Task<CommentDto> Handle(UpdateCommentCommand request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
	{
		var author = _currentUserAccessor.Current
			?? throw new UnauthorizedAccessException("A signed-in author is required to edit a comment.");

		var content = request.Content.Trim();
		if (content.Length == 0)
		{
			throw new ArgumentException("Comment content must not be empty.", nameof(request));
		}

		if (content.Length > CommentLimits.MaxCommentLength)
		{
			throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(
				nameof(request),
				$"Comment content must not exceed {CommentLimits.MaxCommentLength} characters.");
		}

		var comment = await _dbContext.Comment
			.Include(c => c.Author)
			.FirstOrDefaultAsync(c => c.Id == request.CommentId, cancellationToken)
			?? throw new KeyNotFoundException($"Comment {request.CommentId} was not found.");

		if (comment.AuthorId != author.Id)
		{
			throw new UnauthorizedAccessException($"Comment {comment.Id} belongs to another author.");
		}

		if (comment.Status != MZikmund.Web.Data.Entities.CommentStatus.Visible)
		{
			throw new InvalidOperationException($"Comment {comment.Id} is not visible and cannot be edited.");
		}

		var now = _dateProvider.UtcNow.UtcDateTime;
		if (now - comment.CreatedOn > EditWindow)
		{
			throw new InvalidOperationException(
				$"Comment {comment.Id} can only be edited within {EditWindow.TotalMinutes} minutes of posting.");
		}

		// ParentId and MentionedDisplayName are decided once, at creation, and are never re-derived
		// here - re-deriving would double-prefix a mention or silently re-thread an existing reply.
		comment.Content = content;
		comment.ContentHtml = _contentRenderer.RenderHtml(content);
		comment.EditedOn = now;

		await _dbContext.SaveChangesAsync(cancellationToken);

		_logger.LogInformation("Comment {CommentId} edited by its author.", comment.Id);

		return CommentProjection.ToDto(comment, author.Id, includeReplies: false);
	}
}
```

- Produces:
  - `public record DeleteCommentCommand(Guid CommentId) : IRequest, IAuthoredRequest;`
  - `internal sealed class DeleteCommentHandler : IRequestHandler<DeleteCommentCommand>` with the constructor
    `DeleteCommentHandler(DatabaseContext, ICurrentUserAccessor, ILogger<DeleteCommentHandler>)`

MediatR 14 has no `Unit`: a void command implements the non-generic `IRequest` and the handler
implements `IRequestHandler<DeleteCommentCommand>` with `Task Handle(...)`.

Rules pinned here: the delete is a **soft** delete to `CommentStatus.DeletedByAuthor`; the row and all
its replies survive (that is what a tombstone is for — orphaned reply threads are the alternative);
the parent's `ReplyCount` is decremented in the **same transaction**; and deleting an
already-deleted comment is a no-op so the count cannot be decremented twice.

- [ ] **Step 4: Implement the handler — replace the whole body of `src/web/MZikmund.Web.Core/Features/Comments/DeleteCommentHandler.cs`**

```csharp
using MediatR;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using MZikmund.Web.Core.Services.Comments;
using MZikmund.Web.Data;
using MZikmund.Web.Data.Entities;

namespace MZikmund.Web.Core.Features.Comments;

internal sealed class DeleteCommentHandler : IRequestHandler<DeleteCommentCommand>
{
	private readonly DatabaseContext _dbContext;
	private readonly ICurrentUserAccessor _currentUserAccessor;
	private readonly ILogger<DeleteCommentHandler> _logger;

	public DeleteCommentHandler(
		DatabaseContext dbContext,
		ICurrentUserAccessor currentUserAccessor,
		ILogger<DeleteCommentHandler> logger)
	{
		_dbContext = dbContext;
		_currentUserAccessor = currentUserAccessor;
		_logger = logger;
	}

	public async Task Handle(DeleteCommentCommand request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
	{
		var author = _currentUserAccessor.Current
			?? throw new UnauthorizedAccessException("A signed-in author is required to delete a comment.");

		var comment = await _dbContext.Comment
			.FirstOrDefaultAsync(c => c.Id == request.CommentId, cancellationToken)
			?? throw new KeyNotFoundException($"Comment {request.CommentId} was not found.");

		if (comment.AuthorId != author.Id)
		{
			throw new UnauthorizedAccessException($"Comment {comment.Id} belongs to another author.");
		}

		if (comment.Status == MZikmund.Web.Data.Entities.CommentStatus.DeletedByAuthor)
		{
			// Idempotent: a second delete must not decrement the parent's ReplyCount twice.
			return;
		}

		CommentEntity? parent = null;
		if (comment.ParentId is Guid parentId)
		{
			parent = await _dbContext.Comment
				.FirstOrDefaultAsync(c => c.Id == parentId, cancellationToken);
		}

		var strategy = _dbContext.Database.CreateExecutionStrategy();
		await strategy.ExecuteAsync(
			async ct =>
			{
				await using var transaction = await _dbContext.Database.BeginTransactionAsync(ct);

				// The row and its replies stay: a tombstone renders as a placeholder and keeps the
				// thread intact instead of orphaning every reply underneath it.
				comment.Status = MZikmund.Web.Data.Entities.CommentStatus.DeletedByAuthor;
				if (parent is not null && parent.ReplyCount > 0)
				{
					parent.ReplyCount -= 1;
				}

				await _dbContext.SaveChangesAsync(ct);
				await transaction.CommitAsync(ct);
			},
			cancellationToken);

		_logger.LogInformation("Comment {CommentId} soft-deleted by its author.", comment.Id);
	}
}
```

One command serves both `PUT /vote` (`Upvoted: true`) and `DELETE /vote` (`Upvoted: false`). It is
idempotent in **both** directions: voting twice adds one row, un-voting twice removes one row, and
`UpvoteCount` never drifts. An author can never vote on their own comment.

- [ ] **Step 4: Implement the handler — replace the whole body of `src/web/MZikmund.Web.Core/Features/Comments/SetCommentVoteHandler.cs`**

```csharp
using MediatR;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using MZikmund.DataContracts.Blog.Comments;
using MZikmund.Web.Core.Services;
using MZikmund.Web.Core.Services.Comments;
using MZikmund.Web.Data;
using MZikmund.Web.Data.Entities;

namespace MZikmund.Web.Core.Features.Comments;

internal sealed class SetCommentVoteHandler : IRequestHandler<SetCommentVoteCommand, CommentDto>
{
	private readonly DatabaseContext _dbContext;
	private readonly ICurrentUserAccessor _currentUserAccessor;
	private readonly IDateProvider _dateProvider;
	private readonly ILogger<SetCommentVoteHandler> _logger;

	public SetCommentVoteHandler(
		DatabaseContext dbContext,
		ICurrentUserAccessor currentUserAccessor,
		IDateProvider dateProvider,
		ILogger<SetCommentVoteHandler> logger)
	{
		_dbContext = dbContext;
		_currentUserAccessor = currentUserAccessor;
		_dateProvider = dateProvider;
		_logger = logger;
	}

	public async Task<CommentDto> Handle(SetCommentVoteCommand request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
	{
		var author = _currentUserAccessor.Current
			?? throw new UnauthorizedAccessException("A signed-in author is required to vote on a comment.");

		var comment = await _dbContext.Comment
			.Include(c => c.Author)
			.Include(c => c.Votes)
			.FirstOrDefaultAsync(c => c.Id == request.CommentId, cancellationToken)
			?? throw new KeyNotFoundException($"Comment {request.CommentId} was not found.");

		if (comment.AuthorId == author.Id)
		{
			throw new InvalidOperationException("An author cannot vote on their own comment.");
		}

		if (comment.Status != MZikmund.Web.Data.Entities.CommentStatus.Visible)
		{
			throw new InvalidOperationException($"Comment {comment.Id} is not visible and cannot be voted on.");
		}

		var existingVote = await _dbContext.CommentVote
			.FirstOrDefaultAsync(v => v.CommentId == comment.Id && v.AuthorId == author.Id, cancellationToken);

		if (request.Upvoted && existingVote is null)
		{
			var newVote = new CommentVoteEntity
			{
				CommentId = comment.Id,
				AuthorId = author.Id,
				CreatedOn = _dateProvider.UtcNow.UtcDateTime,
			};

			var addStrategy = _dbContext.Database.CreateExecutionStrategy();
			await addStrategy.ExecuteAsync(
				async ct =>
				{
					await using var transaction = await _dbContext.Database.BeginTransactionAsync(ct);
					_dbContext.CommentVote.Add(newVote);
					comment.UpvoteCount += 1;
					await _dbContext.SaveChangesAsync(ct);
					await transaction.CommitAsync(ct);
				},
				cancellationToken);
		}
		else if (!request.Upvoted && existingVote is not null)
		{
			CommentVoteEntity voteToRemove = existingVote;

			var removeStrategy = _dbContext.Database.CreateExecutionStrategy();
			await removeStrategy.ExecuteAsync(
				async ct =>
				{
					await using var transaction = await _dbContext.Database.BeginTransactionAsync(ct);
					_dbContext.CommentVote.Remove(voteToRemove);
					comment.UpvoteCount = Math.Max(0, comment.UpvoteCount - 1);
					await _dbContext.SaveChangesAsync(ct);
					await transaction.CommitAsync(ct);
				},
				cancellationToken);
		}

		// Both remaining combinations - voting when a vote already exists, un-voting when none does -
		// are deliberate no-ops, which is what makes PUT and DELETE idempotent in both directions.
		_logger.LogInformation(
			"Vote on comment {CommentId} by author {AuthorId} set to {Upvoted}.",
			comment.Id,
			author.Id,
			request.Upvoted);

		return CommentProjection.ToDto(comment, author.Id, includeReplies: false);
	}
}
```

A second **open** report from the same reporter on the same comment is suppressed, so one determined
reporter cannot inflate the moderation queue. Once a report is resolved (`ResolvedOn` set) the same
reporter may report again. `ReportCount` moves in the same transaction as the report row.

- [ ] **Step 4: Implement the handler — replace the whole body of `src/web/MZikmund.Web.Core/Features/Comments/ReportCommentHandler.cs`**

```csharp
using MediatR;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using MZikmund.DataContracts.Blog.Comments;
using MZikmund.Web.Core.Services;
using MZikmund.Web.Core.Services.Comments;
using MZikmund.Web.Data;
using MZikmund.Web.Data.Entities;

namespace MZikmund.Web.Core.Features.Comments;

internal sealed class ReportCommentHandler : IRequestHandler<ReportCommentCommand>
{
	private readonly DatabaseContext _dbContext;
	private readonly ICurrentUserAccessor _currentUserAccessor;
	private readonly IDateProvider _dateProvider;
	private readonly ILogger<ReportCommentHandler> _logger;

	public ReportCommentHandler(
		DatabaseContext dbContext,
		ICurrentUserAccessor currentUserAccessor,
		IDateProvider dateProvider,
		ILogger<ReportCommentHandler> logger)
	{
		_dbContext = dbContext;
		_currentUserAccessor = currentUserAccessor;
		_dateProvider = dateProvider;
		_logger = logger;
	}

	public async Task Handle(ReportCommentCommand request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
	{
		var reporter = _currentUserAccessor.Current
			?? throw new UnauthorizedAccessException("A signed-in author is required to report a comment.");

		var note = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(request.Note) ? null : request.Note.Trim();
		if (note is not null && note.Length > CommentLimits.MaxReportNoteLength)
		{
			throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(
				nameof(request),
				$"Report note must not exceed {CommentLimits.MaxReportNoteLength} characters.");
		}

		var comment = await _dbContext.Comment
			.FirstOrDefaultAsync(c => c.Id == request.CommentId, cancellationToken)
			?? throw new KeyNotFoundException($"Comment {request.CommentId} was not found.");

		var alreadyReported = await _dbContext.CommentReport
			.AsNoTracking()
			.AnyAsync(
				r => r.CommentId == comment.Id && r.ReporterId == reporter.Id && r.ResolvedOn == null,
				cancellationToken);
		if (alreadyReported)
		{
			return;
		}

		var report = new CommentReportEntity
		{
			Id = Guid.NewGuid(),
			CommentId = comment.Id,
			ReporterId = reporter.Id,
			Reason = request.Reason,
			Note = note,
			CreatedOn = _dateProvider.UtcNow.UtcDateTime,
			ResolvedOn = null,
		};

		var strategy = _dbContext.Database.CreateExecutionStrategy();
		await strategy.ExecuteAsync(
			async ct =>
			{
				await using var transaction = await _dbContext.Database.BeginTransactionAsync(ct);
				_dbContext.CommentReport.Add(report);
				comment.ReportCount += 1;
				await _dbContext.SaveChangesAsync(ct);
				await transaction.CommitAsync(ct);
			},
			cancellationToken);

		_logger.LogInformation(
			"Comment {CommentId} reported by author {ReporterId} for {Reason}.",
			comment.Id,
			reporter.Id,
			request.Reason);
	}
}
```

## Phase 6: Moderation Handlers (hide, admin-delete, ban, report queue, feed, count)

**Decisions this phase pins down** (state them, do not silently re-litigate):

1. `ReportCount` on `CommentEntity` means **number of unresolved reports**. Every handler that resolves reports drives it to `0`.
2. `CommentStatus` (contract) has no `DeletedByModerator` member. Admin-delete therefore reuses `HiddenByModerator` **and additionally purges `Content`/`ContentHtml` to `""`**; hide leaves the text intact so it can be reversed. Both keep the row, because every comment FK is `DeleteBehavior.Restrict` and replies must not be orphaned.
3. Hide and admin-delete resolve open reports in the **same `SaveChangesAsync` call** as the status change. One `SaveChangesAsync` is one transaction, so no explicit `BeginTransactionAsync` and therefore no `CreateExecutionStrategy()` wrapper is needed here.
4. Bans affect **future writes only**. `BanAuthorHandler` touches exactly one column (`CommentAuthorEntity.IsBanned`) and never touches `CommentEntity`.
5. Admin queries hand-project `CommentDto` (no `IMapper`): `HasUpvoted` and `IsOwn` are always `false` and `Replies` is always empty, because the moderation surface has no per-caller vote state.
6. `CommentsDbFixture` is **consumed exactly as Phase 0 Task 0.7 defines it** — it lives in namespace `MZikmund.Web.Core.Tests.Infrastructure` (so every test file below carries `using MZikmund.Web.Core.Tests.Infrastructure;`) and every `DatabaseContext` it hands out shares **one** database. This phase never redefines, re-creates or "fixes" the fixture. Consequently every test here seeds and asserts through a **single** `CreateContext()`. Test classes whose handler queries are scoped by an id (`HideCommentHandlerTests`, `AdminDeleteCommentHandlerTests`, `BanAuthorHandlerTests`, `BannedAuthorWriteRejectionTests`) share one fixture via `IClassFixture<CommentsDbFixture>`; test classes whose handler queries scan the **whole** database (`GetCommentReportsHandlerTests`, `ResolveCommentReportHandlerTests`, `GetModerationFeedHandlerTests`, `CountNewCommentsHandlerTests`) instead construct their own `using CommentsDbFixture fixture = new();` per test — the per-test usage Phase 0 Task 0.7 explicitly supports — so sibling tests cannot see each other's rows.
7. `src/web/MZikmund.Web.Core/Properties/InternalsVisibleTo.cs` is owned by **Phase 5 Task 5.1** (which `git mv`s the repo's existing `Properties/AssemblyInfo.cs` onto that path). This phase only verifies it, never creates it — a second `[assembly: InternalsVisibleTo]` declaration would be a duplicate-attribute build error.

- [ ] **Step 7: Implement the handler**

Replace the body of `src/web/MZikmund.Web.Core/Features/Comments/HideCommentHandler.cs` with:

```csharp
using MediatR;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using MZikmund.Web.Core.Services;
using MZikmund.Web.Data;

namespace MZikmund.Web.Core.Features.Comments;

internal sealed class HideCommentHandler : IRequestHandler<HideCommentCommand>
{
	private readonly DatabaseContext _dbContext;
	private readonly IDateProvider _dateProvider;
	private readonly ILogger<HideCommentHandler> _logger;

	public HideCommentHandler(
		DatabaseContext dbContext,
		IDateProvider dateProvider,
		ILogger<HideCommentHandler> logger)
	{
		_dbContext = dbContext;
		_dateProvider = dateProvider;
		_logger = logger;
	}

	public async Task Handle(HideCommentCommand request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
	{
		var comment = await _dbContext.Comment
			.FirstOrDefaultAsync(c => c.Id == request.CommentId, cancellationToken);

		if (comment is null)
		{
			throw new KeyNotFoundException($"Comment {request.CommentId} was not found.");
		}

		var openReports = await _dbContext.CommentReport
			.Where(r => r.CommentId == request.CommentId && r.ResolvedOn == null)
			.ToListAsync(cancellationToken);

		var resolvedOn = _dateProvider.UtcNow.UtcDateTime;
		foreach (var report in openReports)
		{
			report.ResolvedOn = resolvedOn;
		}

		comment.Status = MZikmund.Web.Data.Entities.CommentStatus.HiddenByModerator;
		comment.ReportCount = 0;

		// A single SaveChangesAsync puts the status change and the report resolution
		// in one transaction, so the queue entry can never survive the hide.
		await _dbContext.SaveChangesAsync(cancellationToken);

		_logger.LogInformation(
			"Comment {CommentId} hidden by moderator; {OpenReportCount} open report(s) auto-resolved.",
			comment.Id,
			openReports.Count);
	}
}
```

- [ ] **Step 5: Implement the handler**

Replace `src/web/MZikmund.Web.Core/Features/Comments/AdminDeleteCommentHandler.cs` with:

```csharp
using MediatR;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using MZikmund.Web.Core.Services;
using MZikmund.Web.Data;

namespace MZikmund.Web.Core.Features.Comments;

internal sealed class AdminDeleteCommentHandler : IRequestHandler<AdminDeleteCommentCommand>
{
	private readonly DatabaseContext _dbContext;
	private readonly IDateProvider _dateProvider;
	private readonly ILogger<AdminDeleteCommentHandler> _logger;

	public AdminDeleteCommentHandler(
		DatabaseContext dbContext,
		IDateProvider dateProvider,
		ILogger<AdminDeleteCommentHandler> logger)
	{
		_dbContext = dbContext;
		_dateProvider = dateProvider;
		_logger = logger;
	}

	public async Task Handle(AdminDeleteCommentCommand request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
	{
		var comment = await _dbContext.Comment
			.FirstOrDefaultAsync(c => c.Id == request.CommentId, cancellationToken);

		if (comment is null)
		{
			throw new KeyNotFoundException($"Comment {request.CommentId} was not found.");
		}

		var openReports = await _dbContext.CommentReport
			.Where(r => r.CommentId == request.CommentId && r.ResolvedOn == null)
			.ToListAsync(cancellationToken);

		var resolvedOn = _dateProvider.UtcNow.UtcDateTime;
		foreach (var report in openReports)
		{
			report.ResolvedOn = resolvedOn;
		}

		// The row survives so replies keep their parent; only the body is purged.
		comment.Status = MZikmund.Web.Data.Entities.CommentStatus.HiddenByModerator;
		comment.Content = "";
		comment.ContentHtml = "";
		comment.ReportCount = 0;

		await _dbContext.SaveChangesAsync(cancellationToken);

		_logger.LogInformation(
			"Comment {CommentId} deleted by moderator; {OpenReportCount} open report(s) auto-resolved.",
			comment.Id,
			openReports.Count);
	}
}
```

- [ ] **Step 7: Implement the ban handler**

Replace `src/web/MZikmund.Web.Core/Features/Comments/BanAuthorHandler.cs` with:

```csharp
using MediatR;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using MZikmund.Web.Data;

namespace MZikmund.Web.Core.Features.Comments;

internal sealed class BanAuthorHandler : IRequestHandler<BanAuthorCommand>
{
	private readonly DatabaseContext _dbContext;
	private readonly ILogger<BanAuthorHandler> _logger;

	public BanAuthorHandler(DatabaseContext dbContext, ILogger<BanAuthorHandler> logger)
	{
		_dbContext = dbContext;
		_logger = logger;
	}

	public async Task Handle(BanAuthorCommand request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
	{
		var author = await _dbContext.CommentAuthor
			.FirstOrDefaultAsync(a => a.Id == request.AuthorId, cancellationToken);

		if (author is null)
		{
			throw new KeyNotFoundException($"Comment author {request.AuthorId} was not found.");
		}

		if (author.IsBanned)
		{
			return;
		}

		// A ban blocks future writes only; existing comments are never touched here.
		author.IsBanned = true;
		await _dbContext.SaveChangesAsync(cancellationToken);

		_logger.LogInformation(
			"Comment author {AuthorId} banned; existing comments were left visible.",
			author.Id);
	}
}
```

- [ ] **Step 5: Implement the handler**

Replace `src/web/MZikmund.Web.Core/Features/Comments/GetCommentReportsHandler.cs` with:

```csharp
using MediatR;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using MZikmund.DataContracts;
using MZikmund.DataContracts.Blog.Comments;
using MZikmund.Web.Data;

namespace MZikmund.Web.Core.Features.Comments;

internal sealed class GetCommentReportsHandler : IRequestHandler<GetCommentReportsQuery, PagedResponse<CommentReportDto>>
{
	private readonly DatabaseContext _dbContext;

	public GetCommentReportsHandler(DatabaseContext dbContext)
	{
		_dbContext = dbContext;
	}

	public async Task<PagedResponse<CommentReportDto>> Handle(GetCommentReportsQuery request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
	{
		if (request.PageNumber < 1)
		{
			throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(request.PageNumber), "Page number must be at least 1.");
		}

		if (request.PageSize < 1)
		{
			throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(request.PageSize), "Page size must be at least 1.");
		}

		var openReports = _dbContext.CommentReport.Where(r => r.ResolvedOn == null);

		// One queue row per reported comment, so ten reports on one comment count once.
		var totalCount = await openReports
			.Select(r => r.CommentId)
			.Distinct()
			.CountAsync(cancellationToken);

		var skip = (request.PageNumber - 1) * request.PageSize;
		var groups = await openReports
			.GroupBy(r => r.CommentId)
			.Select(g => new
			{
				CommentId = g.Key,
				OpenReportCount = g.Count(),
				FirstReportedOn = g.Min(r => r.CreatedOn)
			})
			.OrderBy(g => g.FirstReportedOn)
			.ThenBy(g => g.CommentId)
			.Skip(skip)
			.Take(request.PageSize)
			.ToArrayAsync(cancellationToken);

		var commentIds = groups.Select(g => g.CommentId).ToArray();

		var reasons = await openReports
			.Where(r => commentIds.Contains(r.CommentId))
			.Select(r => new { r.CommentId, r.Reason })
			.ToArrayAsync(cancellationToken);

		var commentRows = await _dbContext.Comment
			.Where(c => commentIds.Contains(c.Id))
			.Select(c => new
			{
				c.Id,
				c.PostId,
				c.ParentId,
				// AuthorId is what the moderation queue's "ban this author" action posts back.
				c.AuthorId,
				AuthorDisplayName = c.Author.DisplayName,
				AuthorAvatarUrl = c.Author.AvatarUrl,
				c.MentionedDisplayName,
				c.Content,
				c.ContentHtml,
				c.Status,
				c.CreatedOn,
				c.EditedOn,
				c.UpvoteCount,
				c.ReplyCount
			})
			.ToArrayAsync(cancellationToken);

		var commentsById = commentRows.ToDictionary(c => c.Id);

		var items = new List<CommentReportDto>(groups.Length);
		foreach (var group in groups)
		{
			var comment = commentsById[group.CommentId];
			items.Add(new CommentReportDto
			{
				CommentId = group.CommentId,
				AuthorId = comment.AuthorId,
				Comment = new CommentDto
				{
					Id = comment.Id,
					PostId = comment.PostId,
					ParentId = comment.ParentId,
					AuthorDisplayName = comment.AuthorDisplayName,
					AuthorAvatarUrl = comment.AuthorAvatarUrl,
					MentionedDisplayName = comment.MentionedDisplayName,
					Content = comment.Content,
					ContentHtml = comment.ContentHtml,
					Status = (CommentStatus)(int)comment.Status,
					CreatedOn = comment.CreatedOn,
					EditedOn = comment.EditedOn,
					UpvoteCount = comment.UpvoteCount,
					ReplyCount = comment.ReplyCount,
					HasUpvoted = false,
					IsOwn = false,
				},
				OpenReportCount = group.OpenReportCount,
				Reasons = reasons
					.Where(r => r.CommentId == group.CommentId)
					.Select(r => r.Reason)
					.Distinct()
					.OrderBy(r => r)
					.ToArray(),
				FirstReportedOn = group.FirstReportedOn,
			});
		}

		return new PagedResponse<CommentReportDto>(items, request.PageNumber, request.PageSize, totalCount);
	}
}
```

Replace `src/web/MZikmund.Web.Core/Features/Comments/ResolveCommentReportHandler.cs` with:

```csharp
using MediatR;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using MZikmund.Web.Core.Services;
using MZikmund.Web.Data;

namespace MZikmund.Web.Core.Features.Comments;

internal sealed class ResolveCommentReportHandler : IRequestHandler<ResolveCommentReportCommand>
{
	private readonly DatabaseContext _dbContext;
	private readonly IDateProvider _dateProvider;
	private readonly ILogger<ResolveCommentReportHandler> _logger;

	public ResolveCommentReportHandler(
		DatabaseContext dbContext,
		IDateProvider dateProvider,
		ILogger<ResolveCommentReportHandler> logger)
	{
		_dbContext = dbContext;
		_dateProvider = dateProvider;
		_logger = logger;
	}

	public async Task Handle(ResolveCommentReportCommand request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
	{
		var openReports = await _dbContext.CommentReport
			.Where(r => r.CommentId == request.CommentId && r.ResolvedOn == null)
			.ToListAsync(cancellationToken);

		if (openReports.Count == 0)
		{
			return;
		}

		var resolvedOn = _dateProvider.UtcNow.UtcDateTime;
		foreach (var report in openReports)
		{
			report.ResolvedOn = resolvedOn;
		}

		var comment = await _dbContext.Comment
			.FirstOrDefaultAsync(c => c.Id == request.CommentId, cancellationToken);
		if (comment is not null)
		{
			// The comment itself is untouched — this is the "reviewed and dismissed" path.
			comment.ReportCount = 0;
		}

		await _dbContext.SaveChangesAsync(cancellationToken);

		_logger.LogInformation(
			"{OpenReportCount} open report(s) on comment {CommentId} dismissed by moderator.",
			openReports.Count,
			request.CommentId);
	}
}
```

Replace `src/web/MZikmund.Web.Core/Features/Comments/GetModerationFeedHandler.cs` with:

```csharp
using MediatR;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using MZikmund.DataContracts;
using MZikmund.DataContracts.Blog.Comments;
using MZikmund.Web.Data;

namespace MZikmund.Web.Core.Features.Comments;

internal sealed class GetModerationFeedHandler : IRequestHandler<GetModerationFeedQuery, PagedResponse<CommentDto>>
{
	private readonly DatabaseContext _dbContext;

	public GetModerationFeedHandler(DatabaseContext dbContext)
	{
		_dbContext = dbContext;
	}

	public async Task<PagedResponse<CommentDto>> Handle(GetModerationFeedQuery request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
	{
		if (request.PageNumber < 1)
		{
			throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(request.PageNumber), "Page number must be at least 1.");
		}

		if (request.PageSize < 1)
		{
			throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(request.PageSize), "Page size must be at least 1.");
		}

		// The moderation feed deliberately ignores Status — hidden comments must stay visible to the moderator.
		var since = request.Since;
		var query = _dbContext.Comment.Where(c => since == null || c.CreatedOn > since);

		var totalCount = await query.CountAsync(cancellationToken);

		var skip = (request.PageNumber - 1) * request.PageSize;
		var rows = await query
			.OrderByDescending(c => c.CreatedOn)
			.ThenByDescending(c => c.Id)
			.Skip(skip)
			.Take(request.PageSize)
			.Select(c => new
			{
				c.Id,
				c.PostId,
				c.ParentId,
				AuthorDisplayName = c.Author.DisplayName,
				AuthorAvatarUrl = c.Author.AvatarUrl,
				c.MentionedDisplayName,
				c.Content,
				c.ContentHtml,
				c.Status,
				c.CreatedOn,
				c.EditedOn,
				c.UpvoteCount,
				c.ReplyCount
			})
			.ToArrayAsync(cancellationToken);

		var items = rows.Select(c => new CommentDto
		{
			Id = c.Id,
			PostId = c.PostId,
			ParentId = c.ParentId,
			AuthorDisplayName = c.AuthorDisplayName,
			AuthorAvatarUrl = c.AuthorAvatarUrl,
			MentionedDisplayName = c.MentionedDisplayName,
			Content = c.Content,
			ContentHtml = c.ContentHtml,
			Status = (CommentStatus)(int)c.Status,
			CreatedOn = c.CreatedOn,
			EditedOn = c.EditedOn,
			UpvoteCount = c.UpvoteCount,
			ReplyCount = c.ReplyCount,
			HasUpvoted = false,
			IsOwn = false,
		}).ToArray();

		return new PagedResponse<CommentDto>(items, request.PageNumber, request.PageSize, totalCount);
	}
}
```

```csharp
using MediatR;
```

## Phase 7: HTTP Surface — Controllers, Rate Limiting, Turnstile Enforcement, Feature Gate, Refit

**Phase-level context the implementer needs before starting**

- Every route below is copied verbatim from the canonical contract. Do not "improve" them.
- `CommentsController` is the **first controller in this repo** to mix anonymous and authenticated actions. It uses class-level `[Authorize]` with `[AllowAnonymous]` on the two GETs. `[AllowAnonymous]` appears nowhere else in the repo — that is expected.
- The `Comments:Enabled` filter is applied to `CommentsController` **only**. `CommentsAdminController` is deliberately ungated so moderation can be smoke-tested while the feature is dark.
- Missing `[JsonSerializable]` registrations fail at **runtime**, not compile time. Task 7.5 adds a test that catches this.
- `CommentsOptions`, its `services.Configure<CommentsOptions>` binding and the `Comments` section of both appsettings files are **owned by Phase 0 Task 0.3**. Phase 7 consumes them and never re-creates, re-binds or edits them — the committed default in `appsettings.json` stays `"Enabled": false` so the feature ships dark, and Phase 11 Task 11.6 verifies exactly that.
- The rate limits are **configurable**, per the spec: a `RateLimitOptions` POCO in `MZikmund.Web.Configuration`, bound from an optional `"RateLimits"` section, whose defaults are the spec's starting numbers. Nothing in Phase 7 hard-codes a permit limit.
- The route templates in Task 7.3 are the canonical contract's, **verbatim and without `:guid` constraints**, and the reply page size is **20**. Task 7.3's `[InlineData]` assertions pin both. Phase 9 consumes these — it must not add route constraints and must not change the reply page size.
- The Refit method names produced by Task 7.5 are **authoritative**. Phase 10 calls them verbatim; there are no `Upvote…` / `GetModerationComments…` / `GetNewCommentsCount…` aliases.

- Modify: `src/web/MZikmund.Web/Program.cs` (usings block; `ConfigureServices` — after the `AddAuthorization` block)

- [ ] **Step 4: Create the filter**

Create `src/web/MZikmund.Web/Filters/CommentsEnabledFilter.cs`:

```csharp
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc.Filters;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Options;
using MZikmund.Web.Configuration;

namespace MZikmund.Web.Filters;

/// <summary>
/// Returns 404 from the public comment endpoints while <c>Comments:Enabled</c> is false.
/// </summary>
/// <remarks>
/// Deliberately applied to <c>CommentsController</c> only. The admin/moderation controller stays
/// reachable while the feature is dark so production moderation can be smoke-tested.
/// </remarks>
public sealed class CommentsEnabledFilter : IActionFilter
{
	private readonly CommentsOptions _options;

	public CommentsEnabledFilter(IOptions<CommentsOptions> options)
	{
		_options = options.Value;
	}

	public void OnActionExecuting(ActionExecutingContext context)
	{
		if (!_options.Enabled)
		{
			context.Result = new NotFoundResult();
		}
	}

	public void OnActionExecuted(ActionExecutedContext context)
	{
	}
}
```

### Task 7.2: Rate Limiting (configurable, partitioned on user id with IP fallback, 429 + Retry-After)

**Files:**
- Create: `src/web/MZikmund.Web.Configuration/RateLimitRule.cs`
- Create: `src/web/MZikmund.Web.Configuration/RateLimitOptions.cs`
- Create: `src/web/MZikmund.Web/Infrastructure/RateLimitPolicies.cs`
- Create: `src/web/MZikmund.Web/Infrastructure/RateLimitPartitionKeys.cs`
- Modify: `src/web/MZikmund.Web/Program.cs` (usings; `ConfigureServices` — `AddRateLimiter` block; `Configure` — `UseRateLimiter()` between `UseAuthentication()` and `UseAuthorization()`)
- Test: `src/web/MZikmund.Web.Tests/Configuration/RateLimitOptionsTests.cs`
- Test: `src/web/MZikmund.Web.Tests/Infrastructure/RateLimitPartitionKeysTests.cs`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: the `services.AddScoped<CommentsEnabledFilter>();` block from Task 7.1 (used only as the insertion anchor in `Program.cs`).
- Produces:
  - `MZikmund.Web.Configuration.RateLimitRule` — `public int PermitLimit { get; set; }`, `public int WindowMinutes { get; set; }`, `public TimeSpan Window => TimeSpan.FromMinutes(WindowMinutes);`
  - `MZikmund.Web.Configuration.RateLimitOptions` — `public RateLimitRule CommentCreate/CommentVote/CommentReport/GlobalWrites { get; set; }`, defaulted to the spec's starting limits and bound from the optional `"RateLimits"` configuration section.
  - `MZikmund.Web.Infrastructure.RateLimitPolicies` — `public const string CommentCreate = "comments-create";`, `CommentVote = "comments-vote"`, `CommentReport = "comments-report"`. Used by `[EnableRateLimiting(...)]` in Tasks 7.3 and 7.4.
  - `MZikmund.Web.Infrastructure.RateLimitPartitionKeys` — `public static string ForRequest(HttpContext httpContext)` and `public static string ForClientIp(HttpContext httpContext)`.

**Why the limits live in configuration:** the spec (line 217) calls them *"Starting limits, tunable via configuration"*. They are therefore read from an optional `"RateLimits"` section, with the spec's numbers as the POCO's defaults, so no appsettings file has to change here — `appsettings.json` is owned by Phase 0 Task 0.3 and must not gain a second owner. Tuning in production is `RateLimits__CommentCreate__PermitLimit=3` in App Service configuration, or a `"RateLimits"` section added later.

**Known limitations to state in the commit body, not to solve here:** rate-limiter partitions are in-process, so N App Service instances give N × the limit; and `HttpContext.Connection.RemoteIpAddress` behind Azure App Service is the load balancer unless `UseForwardedHeaders` is configured. Both are recorded as follow-ups.

```csharp
namespace MZikmund.Web.Configuration;

/// <summary>
/// One rate limiting rule: how many requests a partition may make inside one window.
/// </summary>
public class RateLimitRule
{
	/// <summary>
	/// Requests permitted inside a single window.
	/// </summary>
	public int PermitLimit { get; set; }

	/// <summary>
	/// Window length, in minutes.
	/// </summary>
	public int WindowMinutes { get; set; }

	/// <summary>
	/// Window length. Derived from <see cref="WindowMinutes"/>, never bound directly — the
	/// configuration binder skips get-only properties.
	/// </summary>
	public TimeSpan Window => TimeSpan.FromMinutes(WindowMinutes);
}
```

- [ ] **Step 4: Create the options POCO**

Create `src/web/MZikmund.Web.Configuration/RateLimitOptions.cs`:

```csharp
namespace MZikmund.Web.Configuration;

/// <summary>
/// Rate limits for the comment write endpoints. Bound from the optional [RateLimits] section.
/// </summary>
/// <remarks>
/// The property defaults are the spec's starting limits, so the section may be absent entirely.
/// Tune without a code change by adding a "RateLimits" section, or in Azure App Service with
/// environment variables such as RateLimits__CommentCreate__PermitLimit.
/// </remarks>
public class RateLimitOptions
{
	/// <summary>
	/// Comment creates, per author. Default: 5 per 10 minutes.
	/// </summary>
	public RateLimitRule CommentCreate { get; set; } = new() { PermitLimit = 5, WindowMinutes = 10 };

	/// <summary>
	/// Votes, per author. Default: 30 per minute.
	/// </summary>
	public RateLimitRule CommentVote { get; set; } = new() { PermitLimit = 30, WindowMinutes = 1 };

	/// <summary>
	/// Reports, per author. Default: 10 per hour.
	/// </summary>
	public RateLimitRule CommentReport { get; set; } = new() { PermitLimit = 10, WindowMinutes = 60 };

	/// <summary>
	/// Every write request, per client IP, on top of the per-endpoint policies. Default: 20 per minute.
	/// </summary>
	public RateLimitRule GlobalWrites { get; set; } = new() { PermitLimit = 20, WindowMinutes = 1 };
}
```

- [ ] **Step 9: Create the partition-key helper**

Create `src/web/MZikmund.Web/Infrastructure/RateLimitPartitionKeys.cs`:

```csharp
using System.Security.Claims;

namespace MZikmund.Web.Infrastructure;

/// <summary>
/// Builds rate limiting partition keys for the comment endpoints.
/// </summary>
public static class RateLimitPartitionKeys
{
	/// <summary>
	/// Authenticated user id when present, client IP otherwise.
	/// </summary>
	/// <remarks>
	/// The identity comes from the Supabase <c>sub</c> claim, NOT <c>User.Identity.Name</c> — a
	/// Supabase token carries no name claim, so every signed-in user would otherwise collapse into
	/// one shared bucket. Keys are prefixed by kind so a crafted user id cannot collide with an IP.
	/// </remarks>
	public static string ForRequest(HttpContext httpContext)
	{
		var subject = httpContext.User.FindFirst(ClaimTypes.NameIdentifier)?.Value
			?? httpContext.User.FindFirst("sub")?.Value;

		return string.IsNullOrEmpty(subject)
			? ForClientIp(httpContext)
			: $"user:{subject}";
	}

	/// <summary>
	/// Client-IP partition key.
	/// </summary>
	public static string ForClientIp(HttpContext httpContext) =>
		$"ip:{httpContext.Connection.RemoteIpAddress?.ToString() ?? "unknown"}";
}
```

- [ ] **Step 13: Add the `AddRateLimiter` registration**

In `src/web/MZikmund.Web/Program.cs`, replace:

```csharp
	// Comments feature gate. The filter is applied to CommentsController only — admin
	// moderation endpoints stay reachable while the feature is dark.
	services.AddScoped<CommentsEnabledFilter>();
```

with:

```csharp
	// Comments feature gate. The filter is applied to CommentsController only — admin
	// moderation endpoints stay reachable while the feature is dark.
	services.AddScoped<CommentsEnabledFilter>();

	// Read once: the limiter policies below are built at startup and never rebuilt, so
	// IOptionsMonitor would buy nothing. An absent section keeps the spec's starting limits.
	var rateLimits = configuration.GetSection("RateLimits").Get<RateLimitOptions>() ?? new RateLimitOptions();

	services.AddRateLimiter(limiterOptions =>
	{
		// The framework default is 503 Service Unavailable; the comment API contract is 429.
		limiterOptions.RejectionStatusCode = StatusCodes.Status429TooManyRequests;

		limiterOptions.OnRejected = (context, cancellationToken) =>
		{
			// Fixed/sliding/token-bucket limiters supply RetryAfter; concurrency limiters do not.
			if (context.Lease.TryGetMetadata(MetadataName.RetryAfter, out var retryAfter))
			{
				context.HttpContext.Response.Headers.RetryAfter =
					((int)retryAfter.TotalSeconds).ToString(NumberFormatInfo.InvariantInfo);
			}

			context.HttpContext.Response.StatusCode = StatusCodes.Status429TooManyRequests;

			context.HttpContext.RequestServices.GetService<ILoggerFactory>()?
				.CreateLogger("MZikmund.RateLimiting")
				.LogWarning(
					"Rate limit hit for {Partition} on {Path}",
					RateLimitPartitionKeys.ForRequest(context.HttpContext),
					context.HttpContext.Request.Path);

			return ValueTask.CompletedTask;
		};

		// Comment creates, per author. Default 5 per 10 minutes; RateLimits:CommentCreate tunes it.
		limiterOptions.AddPolicy(RateLimitPolicies.CommentCreate, httpContext =>
			RateLimitPartition.GetFixedWindowLimiter(
				partitionKey: RateLimitPartitionKeys.ForRequest(httpContext),
				factory: _ => new FixedWindowRateLimiterOptions
				{
					PermitLimit = rateLimits.CommentCreate.PermitLimit,
					Window = rateLimits.CommentCreate.Window,
					// 0: reject immediately rather than stalling an interactive request.
					QueueLimit = 0,
					QueueProcessingOrder = QueueProcessingOrder.OldestFirst,
					AutoReplenishment = true
				}));

		// Votes, per author. Sliding so a window boundary cannot be gamed.
		limiterOptions.AddPolicy(RateLimitPolicies.CommentVote, httpContext =>
			RateLimitPartition.GetSlidingWindowLimiter(
				partitionKey: RateLimitPartitionKeys.ForRequest(httpContext),
				factory: _ => new SlidingWindowRateLimiterOptions
				{
					PermitLimit = rateLimits.CommentVote.PermitLimit,
					Window = rateLimits.CommentVote.Window,
					SegmentsPerWindow = 6,
					QueueLimit = 0,
					QueueProcessingOrder = QueueProcessingOrder.OldestFirst,
					AutoReplenishment = true
				}));

		// Reports, per author. Default 10 per hour.
		limiterOptions.AddPolicy(RateLimitPolicies.CommentReport, httpContext =>
			RateLimitPartition.GetFixedWindowLimiter(
				partitionKey: RateLimitPartitionKeys.ForRequest(httpContext),
				factory: _ => new FixedWindowRateLimiterOptions
				{
					PermitLimit = rateLimits.CommentReport.PermitLimit,
					Window = rateLimits.CommentReport.Window,
					QueueLimit = 0,
					QueueProcessingOrder = QueueProcessingOrder.OldestFirst,
					AutoReplenishment = true
				}));

		// Runs on EVERY request in addition to the endpoint policy, so reads must opt out
		// explicitly or ordinary page views would be throttled.
		limiterOptions.GlobalLimiter = PartitionedRateLimiter.Create<HttpContext, string>(httpContext =>
		{
			var method = httpContext.Request.Method;
			var isWrite = HttpMethods.IsPost(method)
				|| HttpMethods.IsPut(method)
				|| HttpMethods.IsPatch(method)
				|| HttpMethods.IsDelete(method);

			if (!isWrite)
			{
				return RateLimitPartition.GetNoLimiter("reads");
			}

			return RateLimitPartition.GetFixedWindowLimiter(
				partitionKey: RateLimitPartitionKeys.ForClientIp(httpContext),
				factory: _ => new FixedWindowRateLimiterOptions
				{
					PermitLimit = rateLimits.GlobalWrites.PermitLimit,
					Window = rateLimits.GlobalWrites.Window,
					QueueLimit = 0,
					QueueProcessingOrder = QueueProcessingOrder.OldestFirst,
					AutoReplenishment = true
				});
		});
	});
```

- [ ] **Step 16: LIVE — prove the middleware really rejects with 429 and a `Retry-After` header**

The unit tests above cover the partition keys and the option binding; nothing so far has run the middleware. The global write limiter (20 writes per minute per IP) is reachable right now, before any comment endpoint exists, because it runs on every write request — and `UseRateLimiter` sits *before* `UseAuthorization`, so unauthenticated `POST`s are counted and then rejected.

Terminal 1:

```bash
cd "D:/Personal/mzikmund/.claude/worktrees/comments/src/web/MZikmund.Web"
dotnet run --launch-profile https
```

Expected: `Now listening on: https://localhost:7007`. Leave it running.

Terminal 2:

```bash
for i in $(seq 1 22); do
  printf "write %2d -> " "$i"
  curl -sk -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" -X POST "https://localhost:7007/api/v1/admin/posts" \
    -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d "{}"
done
```

Expected output: the first **20** lines end in `401` (rate limiter allowed them, authorization rejected them), lines 21 and 22 end in `429`:

```
write  1 -> 401
...
write 20 -> 401
write 21 -> 429
write 22 -> 429
```

Now prove the header, still in terminal 2:

```bash
curl -sk -o /dev/null -D - -X POST "https://localhost:7007/api/v1/admin/posts" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d "{}" | tr -d '\r' | grep -iE "^(HTTP/|retry-after)"
```

Expected: a `429` status line and a retry hint, e.g.

```
HTTP/1.1 429
retry-after: 60
```

The HTTP version depends on ALPN negotiation (`HTTP/2 429` is equally correct). If `retry-after` is missing, `MetadataName.RetryAfter` was not read in `OnRejected` — re-check Step 13. If every line is `401`, `UseRateLimiter()` never ran — re-check Step 14.

Press `Ctrl+C` in terminal 1 when done. The partitions are in-process, so stopping the app is also how you reset the IP bucket before Task 7.3's live check.

- [ ] **Step 4: Create the controller**

Create `src/web/MZikmund.Web/Controllers/CommentsController.cs`:

```csharp
using MediatR;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.RateLimiting;
using MZikmund.DataContracts.Blog.Comments;
using MZikmund.Web.Core.Features.Comments;
using MZikmund.Web.Core.Services.Comments;
using MZikmund.Web.Filters;
using MZikmund.Web.Infrastructure;

namespace MZikmund.Web.Controllers;

/// <summary>
/// Public API endpoints for post comments.
/// </summary>
/// <remarks>
/// This is the only controller in the solution mixing anonymous and authenticated actions:
/// [Authorize] sits at class level and the two read actions opt out with [AllowAnonymous].
/// </remarks>
[ApiController]
[Authorize]
[Route("api/v1")]
[ServiceFilter(typeof(CommentsEnabledFilter))]
public class CommentsController : Controller
{
	/// <summary>
	/// Header carrying the Cloudflare Turnstile token on web submissions.
	/// </summary>
	public const string TurnstileHeaderName = "CF-Turnstile-Response";

	private const int PageSize = 20;
	private const int RepliesPageSize = 20;

	private readonly IMediator _mediator;
	private readonly ITurnstileVerifier _turnstileVerifier;
	private readonly ILogger<CommentsController> _logger;

	/// <summary>
	/// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="CommentsController"/> class.
	/// </summary>
	/// <param name="mediator">Mediator.</param>
	/// <param name="turnstileVerifier">Cloudflare Turnstile verifier.</param>
	/// <param name="logger">Logger.</param>
	public CommentsController(
		IMediator mediator,
		ITurnstileVerifier turnstileVerifier,
		ILogger<CommentsController> logger)
	{
		_mediator = mediator ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(mediator));
		_turnstileVerifier = turnstileVerifier ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(turnstileVerifier));
		_logger = logger ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(logger));
	}

	/// <summary>
	/// Gets top-level comments for a post, each carrying its first replies.
	/// </summary>
	/// <param name="postId">Post ID.</param>
	/// <param name="sort">Sort order.</param>
	/// <param name="pageNumber">Page number (1-based).</param>
	/// <returns>A page of top-level comments.</returns>
	[HttpGet("posts/{postId}/comments")]
	[AllowAnonymous]
	[ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
	[ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
	public async Task<IActionResult> GetPostComments(
		Guid postId,
		[FromQuery] CommentSortOrder sort = CommentSortOrder.Top,
		[FromQuery] int pageNumber = 1) =>
		Ok(await _mediator.Send(new GetPostCommentsQuery(postId, sort, pageNumber, PageSize)));

	/// <summary>
	/// Gets the replies of a comment beyond the first few returned inline.
	/// </summary>
	/// <param name="id">Parent comment ID.</param>
	/// <param name="pageNumber">Page number (1-based).</param>
	/// <returns>A page of replies, oldest first.</returns>
	[HttpGet("comments/{id}/replies")]
	[AllowAnonymous]
	[ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
	[ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
	public async Task<IActionResult> GetCommentReplies(Guid id, [FromQuery] int pageNumber = 1) =>
		Ok(await _mediator.Send(new GetCommentRepliesQuery(id, pageNumber, RepliesPageSize)));

	/// <summary>
	/// Creates a comment or a reply on a post.
	/// </summary>
	/// <param name="postId">Post ID.</param>
	/// <param name="request">Comment content and optional parent.</param>
	/// <param name="turnstileToken">Cloudflare Turnstile token, when the caller is the web form.</param>
	/// <param name="cancellationToken">Cancellation token.</param>
	/// <returns>The created comment.</returns>
	[HttpPost("posts/{postId}/comments")]
	[EnableRateLimiting(RateLimitPolicies.CommentCreate)]
	[ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
	[ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
	[ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status401Unauthorized)]
	[ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status403Forbidden)]
	[ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
	[ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status429TooManyRequests)]
	public async Task<IActionResult> CreateComment(
		Guid postId,
		[FromBody] CreateCommentRequest request,
		[FromHeader(Name = TurnstileHeaderName)] string? turnstileToken,
		CancellationToken cancellationToken)
	{
		if (!await VerifyTurnstileAsync(turnstileToken, cancellationToken))
		{
			return BadRequest(new
			{
				error = "Captcha verification failed. Please try again."
			});
		}

		return Ok(await _mediator.Send(
			new CreateCommentCommand(postId, request.Content, request.ParentId),
			cancellationToken));
	}

	/// <summary>
	/// Edits the caller's own comment, within the allowed edit window.
	/// </summary>
	/// <param name="id">Comment ID.</param>
	/// <param name="request">New content.</param>
	/// <param name="cancellationToken">Cancellation token.</param>
	/// <returns>The updated comment.</returns>
	[HttpPatch("comments/{id}")]
	[ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
	[ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
	[ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status401Unauthorized)]
	[ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status403Forbidden)]
	[ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
	[ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status409Conflict)]
	public async Task<IActionResult> UpdateComment(
		Guid id,
		[FromBody] UpdateCommentRequest request,
		CancellationToken cancellationToken) =>
		Ok(await _mediator.Send(new UpdateCommentCommand(id, request.Content), cancellationToken));

	/// <summary>
	/// Soft-deletes the caller's own comment, leaving a tombstone so replies survive.
	/// </summary>
	/// <param name="id">Comment ID.</param>
	/// <param name="cancellationToken">Cancellation token.</param>
	/// <returns>No content, when successful.</returns>
	[HttpDelete("comments/{id}")]
	[ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status204NoContent)]
	[ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status401Unauthorized)]
	[ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status403Forbidden)]
	[ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
	public async Task<IActionResult> DeleteComment(Guid id, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
	{
		await _mediator.Send(new DeleteCommentCommand(id), cancellationToken);
		return NoContent();
	}

	/// <summary>
	/// Upvotes a comment. Idempotent.
	/// </summary>
	/// <param name="id">Comment ID.</param>
	/// <param name="cancellationToken">Cancellation token.</param>
	/// <returns>The comment with refreshed vote state.</returns>
	[HttpPut("comments/{id}/vote")]
	[EnableRateLimiting(RateLimitPolicies.CommentVote)]
	[ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
	[ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status401Unauthorized)]
	[ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status403Forbidden)]
	[ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
	[ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status429TooManyRequests)]
	public async Task<IActionResult> AddVote(Guid id, CancellationToken cancellationToken) =>
		Ok(await _mediator.Send(new SetCommentVoteCommand(id, true), cancellationToken));

	/// <summary>
	/// Removes the caller's upvote from a comment. Idempotent.
	/// </summary>
	/// <param name="id">Comment ID.</param>
	/// <param name="cancellationToken">Cancellation token.</param>
	/// <returns>The comment with refreshed vote state.</returns>
	[HttpDelete("comments/{id}/vote")]
	[EnableRateLimiting(RateLimitPolicies.CommentVote)]
	[ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
	[ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status401Unauthorized)]
	[ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
	[ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status429TooManyRequests)]
	public async Task<IActionResult> RemoveVote(Guid id, CancellationToken cancellationToken) =>
		Ok(await _mediator.Send(new SetCommentVoteCommand(id, false), cancellationToken));

	/// <summary>
	/// Reports a comment for moderation.
	/// </summary>
	/// <param name="id">Comment ID.</param>
	/// <param name="request">Report reason and optional note.</param>
	/// <param name="cancellationToken">Cancellation token.</param>
	/// <returns>No content, when successful.</returns>
	[HttpPost("comments/{id}/report")]
	[EnableRateLimiting(RateLimitPolicies.CommentReport)]
	[ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status204NoContent)]
	[ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
	[ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status401Unauthorized)]
	[ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
	[ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status429TooManyRequests)]
	public async Task<IActionResult> ReportComment(
		Guid id,
		[FromBody] ReportCommentRequest request,
		CancellationToken cancellationToken)
	{
		await _mediator.Send(new ReportCommentCommand(id, request.Reason, request.Note), cancellationToken);
		return NoContent();
	}

	/// <summary>
	/// Enforcement predicate: a token that is present MUST verify; an absent token is permitted
	/// and logged, because the Uno app cannot render a Turnstile widget.
	/// </summary>
	private async Task<bool> VerifyTurnstileAsync(string? token, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
	{
		var remoteIp = HttpContext.Connection.RemoteIpAddress?.ToString();

		if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(token))
		{
			_logger.LogInformation(
				"Comment write accepted without a Turnstile token from {RemoteIp}.",
				remoteIp ?? "unknown");
			return true;
		}

		var verified = await _turnstileVerifier.VerifyAsync(token, remoteIp, cancellationToken);
		if (!verified)
		{
			_logger.LogWarning(
				"Turnstile verification failed for a comment write from {RemoteIp}.",
				remoteIp ?? "unknown");
		}

		return verified;
	}
}
```

- [ ] **Step 6: LIVE — prove the 6th create inside 10 minutes returns 429 with `Retry-After`**

This is the spec's *"writes past the limit are rejected"* check (spec line 426), and this task is the first point at which the create endpoint exists to test it against. It needs the local Supabase stack running (Phase 0 Task 0.1) and `$SCRATCH/supabase.env` carrying `READER_TOKEN` (Phase 1 Task 1.1). `Comments:Enabled` is `true` in `appsettings.Development.json`, so the feature gate lets these through.

Terminal 1 — **clear the local Supabase override first, then run the site** (PowerShell):

```powershell
$env:Supabase__LocalUrl = ""
dotnet run --project src/web/MZikmund.Web --launch-profile https
```

Why the first line is mandatory: `$READER_TOKEN` is minted against the **hosted** Supabase project, but in `Development` the `Supabase:LocalUrl` setting (`http://127.0.0.1:54321`) takes precedence, so the API would fetch JWKS from the **local** stack and reject every hosted token with `401`. Emptying the variable makes this run validate against the hosted issuer. It is set for this shell only — close the shell, or run `Remove-Item Env:Supabase__LocalUrl`, once the gate has passed so ordinary local development gets the local stack back.

Expected: `Now listening on: https://localhost:7007`. Leave it running.

Terminal 2 — grab a real post id, then post six comments:

```bash
export SCRATCH="C:/Users/Martin/AppData/Local/Temp/claude/D--Personal-mzikmund/876f8c04-94e6-4eda-91de-cdf93d49d494/scratchpad"
set -a; . "$SCRATCH/supabase.env"; set +a
POST_ID=$(curl -sk "https://localhost:7007/api/v1/posts?pageNumber=1" \
  | python -c "import json,sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin)['data'][0]['id'])")
echo "post: $POST_ID"
for i in $(seq 1 6); do
  printf "create %d -> " "$i"
  curl -sk -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" -X POST "https://localhost:7007/api/v1/posts/$POST_ID/comments" \
    -H "Authorization: Bearer $READER_TOKEN" \
    -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
    -d "{\"content\":\"Rate limit probe $i\"}"
done
```

Expected output, exactly:

```
create 1 -> 200
create 2 -> 200
create 3 -> 200
create 4 -> 200
create 5 -> 200
create 6 -> 429
```

Then prove the rejection carries the header:

```bash
curl -sk -o /dev/null -D - -X POST "https://localhost:7007/api/v1/posts/$POST_ID/comments" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $READER_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d "{\"content\":\"Rate limit probe 7\"}" | tr -d '\r' | grep -iE "^(HTTP/|retry-after)"
```

Expected: a `429` status line and a retry hint of at most 600 seconds, e.g.

```
HTTP/1.1 429
retry-after: 600
```

**Diagnosis if it differs:**
- `create 1 -> 404`: the `CommentsEnabledFilter` short-circuited — the app is not running in `Development`, so `Comments:Enabled` is `false`.
- **every** line `401`: `Supabase__LocalUrl` was not cleared, so the API is checking hosted tokens against the local stack's JWKS and rejects all of them. Stop the app and start it again with `$env:Supabase__LocalUrl = ""` as in Terminal 1 above.
- only **some** lines `401`: `$READER_TOKEN` is stale. Re-mint it (Phase 1 Task 1.1 Step 6).
- `create 6 -> 200`: `[EnableRateLimiting(RateLimitPolicies.CommentCreate)]` is missing from `CreateComment`, or `UseRateLimiter()` is not in the pipeline (Task 7.2 Step 14).
- every create `429` from the start: the per-IP global bucket from Task 7.2 Step 16 is still full. Stop the app and start it again — the partitions are in-process.

The five accepted probe comments stay in the local development database. They are dev data; delete them later from the moderation UI or leave them.

Press `Ctrl+C` in terminal 1 when done.

Create `src/web/MZikmund.Web/Controllers/Admin/CommentsAdminController.cs`:

```csharp
using MediatR;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;
using MZikmund.Web.Core.Features.Comments;

namespace MZikmund.Web.Controllers.Admin;

/// <summary>
/// Admin moderation operations for comments.
/// </summary>
/// <remarks>
/// Deliberately NOT decorated with the Comments:Enabled filter — moderation must stay reachable
/// while the public feature is dark so production can be smoke-tested.
/// </remarks>
[ApiController]
[Authorize(Policy = "AdminPolicy")]
[Route("api/v1/admin/comments")]
public class CommentsAdminController : Controller
{
	private const int PageSize = 20;
	private readonly IMediator _mediator;

	/// <summary>
	/// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="CommentsAdminController"/> class.
	/// </summary>
	/// <param name="mediator">Mediator.</param>
	public CommentsAdminController(IMediator mediator) =>
		_mediator = mediator ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(mediator));

	/// <summary>
	/// Gets the open report queue, grouped by comment.
	/// </summary>
	/// <param name="pageNumber">Page number (1-based).</param>
	/// <returns>A page of reported comments.</returns>
	[HttpGet("reports")]
	[ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
	[ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status401Unauthorized)]
	[ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status403Forbidden)]
	public async Task<IActionResult> GetReports([FromQuery] int pageNumber = 1) =>
		Ok(await _mediator.Send(new GetCommentReportsQuery(pageNumber, PageSize)));

	/// <summary>
	/// Dismisses every open report on a comment without moderating the comment itself.
	/// </summary>
	/// <param name="commentId">Comment ID.</param>
	/// <param name="cancellationToken">Cancellation token.</param>
	/// <returns>No content, when successful.</returns>
	[HttpPost("reports/{commentId}/resolve")]
	[ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status204NoContent)]
	[ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status401Unauthorized)]
	[ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status403Forbidden)]
	[ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
	public async Task<IActionResult> ResolveReport(Guid commentId, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
	{
		await _mediator.Send(new ResolveCommentReportCommand(commentId), cancellationToken);
		return NoContent();
	}

	/// <summary>
	/// Gets the newest-first moderation feed.
	/// </summary>
	/// <param name="since">Only comments created after this instant.</param>
	/// <param name="pageNumber">Page number (1-based).</param>
	/// <returns>A page of comments, newest first.</returns>
	[HttpGet("")]
	[ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
	[ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status401Unauthorized)]
	[ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status403Forbidden)]
	public async Task<IActionResult> GetModerationFeed(
		[FromQuery] DateTime? since = null,
		[FromQuery] int pageNumber = 1) =>
		Ok(await _mediator.Send(new GetModerationFeedQuery(since, pageNumber, PageSize)));

	/// <summary>
	/// Counts comments created since the given instant, for the app's unread badge.
	/// </summary>
	/// <param name="since">Only comments created after this instant.</param>
	/// <returns>The number of new comments.</returns>
	[HttpGet("count")]
	[ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
	[ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status401Unauthorized)]
	[ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status403Forbidden)]
	public async Task<IActionResult> CountNewComments([FromQuery] DateTime? since = null) =>
		Ok(await _mediator.Send(new CountNewCommentsQuery(since)));

	/// <summary>
	/// Hides a comment from public view and auto-resolves its open reports.
	/// </summary>
	/// <param name="id">Comment ID.</param>
	/// <param name="cancellationToken">Cancellation token.</param>
	/// <returns>No content, when successful.</returns>
	[HttpPost("{id}/hide")]
	[ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status204NoContent)]
	[ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status401Unauthorized)]
	[ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status403Forbidden)]
	[ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
	public async Task<IActionResult> HideComment(Guid id, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
	{
		await _mediator.Send(new HideCommentCommand(id), cancellationToken);
		return NoContent();
	}

	/// <summary>
	/// Deletes a comment as a moderator and auto-resolves its open reports.
	/// </summary>
	/// <param name="id">Comment ID.</param>
	/// <param name="cancellationToken">Cancellation token.</param>
	/// <returns>No content, when successful.</returns>
	[HttpDelete("{id}")]
	[ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status204NoContent)]
	[ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status401Unauthorized)]
	[ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status403Forbidden)]
	[ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
	public async Task<IActionResult> DeleteComment(Guid id, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
	{
		await _mediator.Send(new AdminDeleteCommentCommand(id), cancellationToken);
		return NoContent();
	}

	/// <summary>
	/// Bans a comment author from future writes. Existing comments are left visible.
	/// </summary>
	/// <param name="id">Author ID.</param>
	/// <param name="cancellationToken">Cancellation token.</param>
	/// <returns>No content, when successful.</returns>
	/// <remarks>
	/// The leading <c>~/</c> escapes the class-level <c>api/v1/admin/comments</c> prefix so the
	/// route matches the contract exactly.
	/// </remarks>
	[HttpPost("~/api/v1/admin/authors/{id}/ban")]
	[ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status204NoContent)]
	[ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status401Unauthorized)]
	[ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status403Forbidden)]
	[ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
	public async Task<IActionResult> BanAuthor(Guid id, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
	{
		await _mediator.Send(new BanAuthorCommand(id), cancellationToken);
		return NoContent();
	}
}
```

Terminal 1 — **clear the local Supabase override first, then run the site** (PowerShell):

